title: Mapping the North American CSR Landscape: Exploring the Employee - CSR Relationship

detail.title: Mapping the North American CSR Landscape: Exploring the Employee - CSR Relationship

declarations.funderStatement: Crowdera

detail.abstract: As CSR is a trending practice that can bring important value to organizations, it is crucial for them to understand how to navigate this practice. This paper is aimed to map the North American CSR landscape to provide organizations with an overview of what they should consider when engaging in CSR activities as well as an analysis of the unfamiliar concept of the employee-CSR relationship. Our findings conclude that this relationship is a key success factor for organizations' CSR activities.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过绘制北美CSR（企业社会责任）实践图景，分析了员工-CSR关系这一关键成功因素，为企业有效开展CSR活动提供指导。
AI.research_question: 北美CSR实践图景如何？员工与CSR之间的关系是什么？这种关系如何影响CSR活动的成功？
AI.motivation: CSR作为能为组织带来重要价值的趋势性实践，企业需要了解如何有效开展CSR活动，特别是理解员工-CSR关系这一不熟悉的概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任理论、利益相关者理论、员工参与理论、组织行为学理论
AI.method: 对北美CSR实践进行图景绘制（mapping），可能包括文献综述、案例研究、调查分析等方法
AI.findings: 员工-CSR关系是组织CSR活动的关键成功因素
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对员工-CSR关系的理论理解，为CSR研究提供了新的视角，丰富了利益相关者理论在CSR领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了北美CSR实践图景的概览，帮助企业了解开展CSR活动时应考虑的因素，强调了员工参与在CSR成功中的重要性

title: The Effect of Western Technology on Soviet Industrial Development
affiliations: University of Helsinki - Faculty of Social Sciences and University of Helsinki

detail.title: The Effect of Western Technology on Soviet Industrial Development

publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: During the Soviet Union’s First Five-Year Plan, Western know-how and technology were extensively infused into industry through technical assistance agreements and work contracts with specialists and foreign companies. We study the causal effects of this purposeful state-led policy on labor productivity using the largest single recruitment effort of Western expertise, namely Karelian Technical Aid. This allows us to exploit exogenous variation in transfer of technology within one sector: the wood processing industry. Combining detailed individual-level data on over 5,000 North American specialists with a novel panel of accounting data on the universe of Soviet enterprises in Karelia and the Northern Region during the interwar period, we document large and persistent causal productivity gains. Important drivers of successful technology absorption were local human capital and the absence of language barriers.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了苏联第一个五年计划期间，通过技术援助协议和外国专家合同向工业领域注入西方技术知识对劳动生产率的影响。利用卡累利阿技术援助这一最大规模的西方专业知识引进项目，研究发现这种国家主导的技术转移政策带来了显著且持久的劳动生产率提升，成功吸收技术的关键驱动因素是当地人力资本和语言无障碍。
AI.research_question: 苏联第一个五年计划期间，国家主导的西方技术转移政策对劳动生产率有何因果效应？成功吸收技术的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解国家主导的技术转移政策在发展中国家的有效性，特别是在苏联早期工业化背景下，西方技术知识如何通过技术援助协议和外国专家合同影响企业生产率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术转移理论、人力资本理论、吸收能力理论、国家主导的工业化政策
AI.method: 利用卡累利阿技术援助作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法分析技术转移的因果效应。结合5000多名北美专家的个人层面数据和苏联企业在卡累利阿及北部地区的会计面板数据，研究木材加工行业内的技术转移。
AI.findings: 西方技术转移带来了显著且持久的劳动生产率提升。成功吸收技术的关键驱动因素是当地人力资本和语言无障碍（北美专家与当地工人之间）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为技术转移理论提供了实证证据，特别是国家主导的技术引进政策在发展中国家的有效性；强调了人力资本和语言能力在技术吸收中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家制定技术引进政策提供参考，强调在引进外国技术时需要配套的本地人力资本建设和语言沟通能力培养。

title: NGO and Charity Fundraising Network Effects

detail.title: NGO and Charity Fundraising Network Effects

declarations.funderStatement: Crowdera

detail.abstract: The concept of network effects has been extensively studied by economists and business professionals since the 1980s (McIntyre & Srinivasan, 2016).  Yet there is a dearth of practical research relating to network effects within the online fundraising space. Though it makes logical sense that a larger network will result in more funds being raised, many charitable organizations are not leveraging their networks to their full capacity. This paper endeavors to shed light on charity fundraising in Canada, the United States, and Singapore, specifically investigating the mechanisms by which nonprofit organizations currently fundraise, and the receptiveness of the various markets to the use of online team fundraising platforms. The findings of this paper are based on a combination of primary and secondary research, including both survey data as well as data collected from academic and government sources. The principal objective of the research is to gauge the extent to which charitable organizations currently leverage network effects to amplify their fundraising, as well as to better understand the characteristics of the nonprofit market as a whole.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非营利组织如何利用网络效应提升在线筹款效果，通过调查加拿大、美国和新加坡的慈善筹款机制，分析这些市场对在线团队筹款平台的接受度。
AI.research_question: 慈善组织如何利用网络效应来扩大筹款规模？不同市场（加拿大、美国、新加坡）对在线团队筹款平台的接受程度如何？
AI.motivation: 网络效应概念自1980年代以来已被广泛研究，但在在线筹款领域的实践研究相对缺乏。虽然理论上更大的网络会带来更多筹款，但许多慈善组织未能充分利用其网络潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络效应理论（Network Effects Theory）——探讨网络规模如何影响价值创造和资源获取。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：结合一手和二手研究，包括调查数据以及从学术和政府来源收集的数据。
AI.findings: 研究结果揭示了加拿大、美国和新加坡非营利组织当前的筹款机制，以及这些市场对在线团队筹款平台的接受程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将网络效应理论应用于慈善筹款领域，填补了该领域实践研究的空白，为网络效应在非营利环境中的应用提供理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助慈善组织更好地理解和利用网络效应来扩大筹款规模，为在线筹款平台开发提供市场洞察，促进非营利部门筹款效率的提升。

title: When Experts Speak: Sequential LLM-Bayesian Learning for Startup Success Prediction *
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology - Department of Electronic Commerce, New Jersey Institute of Technology, Martin Tuchman School of Management, Tsinghua University - PBC School of Finance, University of Delaware and Hefei University of Technology

detail.title: When Experts Speak: Sequential LLM-Bayesian Learning for Startup Success Prediction *
detail.abstract: Evaluating startups is inherently challenging in entrepreneurial finance, where investors confront severe information asymmetry and limited quantitative data. Leveraging a novel expert network call data, we develop an LLM-Bayesian model that analyzes these conversations at the question-answer turn level, extracting semantic and evaluative signals via large language models (LLMs) and aggregating them in a sequential Bayesian architecture. The model dynamically updates beliefs as additional expert calls occur and attenuates contradictory assessments, which are absent from existing text-based screening tools. Our model outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks by 6.69% in F1-score and increases portfolio-level Return on Investment by 15.26%. Attention and ablation analyses reveal that conversational cues are particularly informative for technologically complex startups, young firms, diverse founding teams, and firms with low public visibility. By converting expert dialogue into continually updated probabilities, our model advances research in entrepreneurial finance and information systems and offers policy implications for improving funding outcomes for informationally disadvantaged startups.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个LLM-贝叶斯模型，通过分析专家网络对话来评估初创企业，解决了创业投资中的信息不对称问题。模型在问题-回答层面提取语义和评估信号，通过序列贝叶斯架构动态更新信念，显著提升了投资决策的准确性和回报率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用专家网络对话数据，通过LLM和贝叶斯模型来更准确地评估初创企业，解决创业投资中的信息不对称问题？
AI.motivation: 创业投资中投资者面临严重的信息不对称和有限的定量数据，传统的基于文本的筛选工具无法有效处理专家对话中的矛盾评估和动态信息更新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合大型语言模型（LLMs）的自然语言处理能力和贝叶斯统计的序列更新框架，构建了一个动态评估模型。理论基础包括信息不对称理论、信号理论和贝叶斯学习理论。
AI.method: 使用新颖的专家网络通话数据，在问题-回答层面分析对话，通过LLMs提取语义和评估信号，在序列贝叶斯架构中聚合这些信号，动态更新信念并减弱矛盾评估。
AI.findings: 模型在F1分数上优于最先进基准6.69%，投资组合层面的投资回报率提高15.26%。对话线索对技术复杂的初创企业、年轻公司、多元化创始团队和公众知名度低的公司特别有信息价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将专家对话转化为持续更新的概率，推进了创业金融和信息系统的研究；提出了结合LLM和贝叶斯学习的动态评估框架；揭示了对话线索在不同类型初创企业中的差异化价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更准确的初创企业评估工具；改善了信息劣势初创企业的融资结果；提供了政策启示；模型可应用于实际投资决策，提高投资回报。

title: Funding Decisions and Securitization of Euro Area Banks: The Effects of Monetary Policy Measures and Market Developments
affiliations: KU Leuven, Department Accounting, Finance and Insurance

detail.title: Funding Decisions and Securitization of Euro Area Banks: The Effects of Monetary Policy Measures and Market Developments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The views expressed in this study are my own and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Central Bank or the Eurosystem.
declarations.funderStatement: Scopelliti acknowledges financial support from Internal Funds KU Leuven (STG/21/048).

detail.abstract: This paper analyses the effects of non-standard monetary policy measures and interbank market developments on banks’ funding decisions via capital markets instruments. I study the determinants for the issuance and the retention of secured debt instruments by euro area banks, based on a granular dataset for asset-backed securities (ABSs) and covered bonds issued in the euro area from 2005 to 2018, and combining tranche-level information on securities with the balance sheet data for the parent banks. While covered bonds are usually placed among investors, ABSs have been often retained by originator banks since the global financial crisis. I find that the full allotment policy – expanding the amount of available central bank liquidity – increased the probability to retain eligible ABSs particularly for banks with lower liquidity and less capital, as more interested in having access to central bank liquidity. In addition to this quantity effect, also the price effect of the interbank spread on funding costs explained the increase in ABS retention for banks in weaker funding liquidity conditions. By contrast, the introduction of the Additional Credit Claims framework, allowing for the direct pledge of credit claims, contributed to a decrease in the retention of the ABSs backed by eligible loans.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了非常规货币政策措施和银行间市场发展如何影响银行通过资本市场工具的融资决策，重点关注欧元区银行发行和保留担保债务工具的决定因素。
AI.research_question: 非常规货币政策措施（如全额分配政策）和银行间市场发展如何影响欧元区银行发行和保留资产支持证券（ABS）和担保债券的决定？
AI.motivation: 自全球金融危机以来，银行越来越多地保留ABS而非出售给投资者，这一现象需要解释。理解货币政策措施如何影响银行的融资决策对监管和政策制定很重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行融资决策理论，结合流动性约束、资本充足率和融资成本考量，分析银行在发行担保债务工具时的选择行为。
AI.method: 使用2005-2018年欧元区ABS和担保债券的细粒度数据集，结合证券层级信息和母银行资产负债表数据，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 全额分配政策增加了银行保留合格ABS的概率，特别是对流动性和资本较低的银行；2. 银行间利差的价格效应也解释了ABS保留的增加；3. 引入额外信贷债权框架减少了合格贷款支持的ABS保留。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了银行融资决策理论，特别关注非常规货币政策通过数量和价格渠道对银行担保融资行为的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行政策制定者提供了关于货币政策工具如何影响银行融资行为的实证证据，有助于优化流动性管理政策和监管框架设计。

title: The Role of Credit Lines in Funding Corporate Takeovers

detail.title: The Role of Credit Lines in Funding Corporate Takeovers
detail.abstract: I provide new evidence on the role of credit lines in M&A, using hand-collected data on the sources of funds in 1,400 cash and mixed bids by US acquirers, 1994–2020. I show that credit lines are the most common liquidity source, funding entirely 23% and partially 57% of the cash payments. The usage of credit lines is particularly prevalent among financially constrained acquirers, whose access to alternative funding may be limited, and when time is of the essence. Moreover, M&A transactions financed with new or amended credit lines, which require bank approval, tend to have higher bidder returns, synergy gains, and lower premiums paid to targets than deals financed from other sources. Overall, my findings are consistent with credit lines providing firms with financial flexibility and valuable creditor screening.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用1994-2020年美国1400个现金和混合并购交易的手工收集数据，发现信用额度是并购中最常见的流动性来源，完全资助23%且部分资助57%的现金支付。信用额度使用在财务受限收购方和时间紧迫时尤为普遍，且通过新设或修订信用额度融资的交易具有更高的收购方回报、协同效应收益和更低的收购溢价。
AI.research_question: 信用额度在并购融资中扮演什么角色？信用额度融资的并购交易是否比其他融资来源的交易表现更好？
AI.motivation: 虽然信用额度是企业重要的流动性来源，但关于其在并购融资中的具体作用和效果缺乏系统性证据。了解信用额度在并购中的使用模式及其对交易结果的影响，对理解企业融资决策和银行信贷筛选价值具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务约束理论、信贷筛选理论、并购融资决策理论。研究基于信用额度提供财务灵活性、银行作为信息中介进行筛选监督的理论框架。
AI.method: 手工收集1994-2020年美国1400个现金和混合并购交易的资金来源数据，进行描述性统计和回归分析，比较不同融资来源的交易特征和绩效差异。
AI.findings: 1. 信用额度是最常见的并购流动性来源，完全资助23%且部分资助57%的现金支付；2. 财务受限收购方和时间紧迫时更依赖信用额度；3. 通过新设或修订信用额度融资的交易具有更高的收购方回报、协同效应收益和更低的收购溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信用额度作为企业财务灵活性工具的理论提供实证支持，验证银行信贷筛选在并购中的价值，丰富并购融资决策的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业并购融资决策提供参考，帮助管理者理解信用额度融资的优势；为银行评估并购信贷提供依据；为投资者评估并购交易质量提供新视角。

title: Nowcasting GCC GDP
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), , International Monetary Fund (IMF) and

detail.title: Nowcasting GCC GDP

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper presents a machine learning–based nowcasting framework for estimating quarterly non-oil GDP growth in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries. Leveraging machine learning models tailored to each country, the framework integrates a broad range of high-frequency indicators—including real activity, financial conditions, trade, and oil-related variables—to produce timely, sector-specific estimates. Advancing the nowcasting literature for the MENA region, this approach moves beyond single-model methodologies by incorporating a richer set of high-frequency, cross-border indicators. It presents two key innovations: (i) a tailored data integration strategy that broadens and automates the use of high-frequency indicators; and (ii) a novel application of Shapley value decompositions to enhance model interpretability and guide the iterative selection of predictive indicators. The framework’s flexibility allows it to account for the region’s unique economic structures, ongoing reform agendas, and the spillover effects of oil market volatility on non-oil sectors. By enhancing the granularity, responsiveness, and transparency of short-term forecasts, the model enables faster, data-driven policy decisions strengthening economic surveillance and enhancing policy agility across the GCC amid a rapidly evolving global environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于机器学习的实时预测框架，用于估计海湾合作委员会（GCC）国家的季度非石油GDP增长。该框架利用针对每个国家定制的机器学习模型，整合了广泛的高频指标（包括实际活动、金融状况、贸易和石油相关变量），以生成及时的部门特定估计。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个基于机器学习的实时预测框架，准确估计海湾合作委员会（GCC）国家的季度非石油GDP增长？
AI.motivation: 需要为中东和北非（MENA）地区开发更先进的实时预测方法，超越单一模型方法，考虑该地区独特的经济结构、改革议程和石油市场波动对非石油部门的溢出效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习实时预测理论、高频指标整合理论、Shapley值分解理论、经济溢出效应理论。
AI.method: 基于机器学习的实时预测框架，包括：1）针对每个国家的定制机器学习模型；2）整合广泛高频指标的数据集成策略；3）使用Shapley值分解增强模型可解释性；4）迭代选择预测指标的方法。
AI.findings: 该框架能够生成更精细、响应更快、更透明的短期预测，考虑了地区独特的经济结构、改革议程和石油市场波动对非石油部门的溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）推进了MENA地区的实时预测文献；2）提出了超越单一模型的更丰富高频跨境指标整合方法；3）引入了Shapley值分解在实时预测中的创新应用；4）开发了增强模型可解释性的新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为GCC国家提供更及时、数据驱动的政策决策支持；2）增强经济监测能力；3）提高政策灵活性；4）支持快速变化的全球环境下的经济管理。

title: Underpriced and Overused
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), , , International Monetary Fund (IMF), World Bank and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Underpriced and Overused

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides a bi-annual assessment of efficient fossil fuel prices and subsidies for 170 countries, based on a comprehensive analysis of environmental and other externalities from fuel consumption. Globally, explicit (or fiscal) subsidies were $725 billion (0.6 percent of GDP) in 2024. Implicit subsidies, primarily underpricing of environmental costs, were $6.7 trillion (5.8 percent of GDP), with three quarters from underpriced air pollution and climate change.* Relative to GDP, explicit subsidies have stablized at pre-COVID levels while implicit subidies have increased somewhat and are expected to rise gradually until 2035. Explicit subsidy removal would reduce CO2 emissions by six percent below baseline levels in 2035, avoid 70,000 premature air pollution deaths annually, raise 0.6 percent of GDP in government revenue, and generate net economic benefits worth 0.5 percent of GDP. Removal of both explicit and implicit subsidies (through corrective taxes) generates substantially larger benefits, such as 1.1 million fewer premature air pollution deaths and a 46 percent reduction in CO2 emissions, but would be politically difficult. Subsidizing fuels is an inefficient way to support low-income households: for every dollar spent on explicit fuel subsidies, the poorest 20 percent of households receive just 8 cents.

AI.tldr: 该研究对170个国家的化石燃料价格和补贴进行半年期评估，发现2024年全球显性补贴为7250亿美元（占GDP的0.6%），隐性补贴高达6.7万亿美元（占GDP的5.8%）。取消显性补贴可在2035年减少6%的碳排放，避免7万例空气污染相关早逝，增加0.6%的政府收入。取消所有补贴效益更大，但政治难度高。
AI.research_question: 全球化石燃料补贴的规模、构成及其经济、环境和社会影响是什么？取消这些补贴会带来哪些效益和挑战？
AI.motivation: 化石燃料补贴导致资源配置扭曲，加剧环境污染和气候变化，同时补贴分配效率低下，对低收入家庭支持效果有限。需要全面评估补贴的经济、环境和社会成本，为政策改革提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外部性理论（环境外部性、健康外部性）、公共财政理论（税收与补贴的效率）、福利经济学（分配效应）和能源经济学（能源定价与消费行为）。
AI.method: 对170个国家进行半年期评估，采用综合分析方法量化化石燃料消费的环境和其他外部性成本，区分显性（财政）补贴和隐性（环境成本低估）补贴，并进行政策模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1. 2024年全球显性补贴7250亿美元（GDP的0.6%），隐性补贴6.7万亿美元（GDP的5.8%），其中四分之三来自空气污染和气候变化成本低估；2. 显性补贴稳定在疫情前水平，隐性补贴略有上升并预计持续增长至2035年；3. 取消显性补贴可在2035年减少6%碳排放，避免7万例早逝，增加0.6%政府收入；4. 取消所有补贴效益更大但政治难度高；5. 燃料补贴对低收入家庭支持效率极低（每1美元补贴中仅8美分惠及最贫困20%家庭）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了全面的化石燃料补贴评估框架，区分显性和隐性补贴；2. 量化了环境外部性（特别是空气污染和气候变化）的经济成本；3. 揭示了补贴政策的分配效率问题；4. 为能源定价改革提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为各国政府提供了化石燃料补贴改革的具体数据支持；2. 展示了取消补贴的多重效益（环境、健康、财政、经济）；3. 揭示了补贴政策的低效分配问题，为更有针对性的社会支持政策提供依据；4. 为国际气候和环境政策制定提供了实证基础。

title: Brazil's VAT Reform
affiliations: , , ,  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Brazil's VAT Reform

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Brazil’s landmark VAT reform, approved in December 2023, will profoundly alter the way consumption taxes are raised across three levels of government. The dual VAT will replace five overlapping taxes, address major inefficiencies of the current system, and simplify and harmonize a widely scattered tax landscape. While the objective of revenue neutrality is anchored in the reform law, deep structural changes will generate uncertainty about the expected revenue collection. This paper estimates consumption tax revenues under the new VAT based on an adjusted IMF's RA-GAP framework taking into account Brazil’s specificities and documents sectoral shifts in tax burdens. We simulate a wide set of scenarios, modifying key assumptions including on the compliance gap and informality, while being guided by legislated decisions on rates and exemptions. Our findings indicate that minimizing the compliance gap will be the most effective way towards ensuring revenue neutrality. To address revenue risks and unleash the reform’s benefits, full integration of operations and effective management of the input tax credit mechanism are critical.

AI.tldr: 巴西2023年通过的增值税改革将取代五种重叠税种，简化税制，但收入中性目标面临不确定性。本文基于调整后的IMF RA-GAP框架估算新VAT下的税收收入，发现减少合规缺口是确保收入中性的最有效途径。
AI.research_question: 巴西增值税改革后，新税制下的消费税收收入将如何变化？如何确保改革实现收入中性目标？
AI.motivation: 巴西2023年通过的增值税改革将深刻改变三级政府的消费税收方式，但结构性变化带来收入不确定性，需要评估改革对税收收入的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际货币基金组织的RA-GAP（收入差距）框架，结合巴西具体情况进行调整，分析增值税改革的收入影响。
AI.method: 采用调整后的IMF RA-GAP框架，考虑巴西特殊性，模拟多种情景（包括合规缺口和非正规经济等关键假设），基于法定税率和豁免规定进行分析。
AI.findings: 最小化合规缺口是确保收入中性最有效的途径；全面整合运营和有效管理进项税抵免机制对降低收入风险和释放改革效益至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将IMF的RA-GAP框架应用于巴西增值税改革的具体情境，为发展中国家大规模税制改革的收入影响评估提供方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西政策制定者提供确保增值税改革收入中性的具体建议，识别关键风险领域，指导改革实施过程中的操作整合和进项税管理。

title: Cyclical Inequality in the Cost of Living and Implications for Monetary Policy
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), University of International Business and Economics and Peking University

detail.title: Cyclical Inequality in the Cost of Living and Implications for Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper documents that households with higher marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) tend to consume goods with more flexible prices. Consequently, they face more cyclical and volatile inflation and experience higher inflation following an expansionary monetary policy shock. We embed this MPC-price stickiness relationship into a tractable multi-sector Two-Agent New Keynesian (TANK) model and analytically demonstrate that it dampens the effectiveness of monetary policy, reducing its efficacy by about 15% relative to a benchmark model with homogeneous consumption baskets. Introducing heterogeneous baskets also generates an inherently inefficient flexible-price equilibrium, which gives rise to a novel trade-off between stabilization and redistribution. The optimal monetary policy therefore differs qualitatively from the standard TANK policy prescription.

AI.tldr: 研究发现高边际消费倾向家庭倾向于消费价格弹性更大的商品，导致他们面临更周期性波动的通胀，这降低了货币政策有效性约15%，并产生了稳定与再分配之间的权衡
AI.research_question: 家庭边际消费倾向与消费篮子价格粘性之间的关系如何影响货币政策传导机制和有效性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究忽略了家庭消费偏好的异质性对货币政策传导的影响，特别是高MPC家庭倾向于消费价格更灵活的商品这一现象
AI.theoretical_framework: 多部门两代理人新凯恩斯模型（TANK），结合了家庭异质性消费篮子和价格粘性差异
AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合，将MPC-价格粘性关系嵌入可处理的多部门TANK模型进行解析推导
AI.findings: 1. 高MPC家庭消费价格更灵活的商品，面临更波动的通胀；2. 这种异质性使货币政策有效性降低约15%；3. 产生稳定与再分配的新权衡；4. 最优货币政策与标准TANK建议有质的不同
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将消费篮子异质性纳入TANK框架；2. 揭示了MPC与价格粘性的系统性关系；3. 提出了稳定与再分配的新权衡理论；4. 修正了最优货币政策理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行制定货币政策提供新视角；2. 揭示了货币政策传导的微观基础；3. 为通胀管理提供更精细的政策工具；4. 有助于理解不同家庭对货币政策的异质性反应

title: Unlocking MENA and CCA Trade in a Fragmented World
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF),  and

detail.title: Unlocking MENA and CCA Trade in a Fragmented World

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of geoeconomic fragmentation on trade flows in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) and Middle East and North Africa (MENA) regions. Amidst ongoing conflicts, security threats, the spike in global economic uncertainty, and evolving consumer sentiments, these regions face intricate challenges that necessitate agile policy responses. The analysis presents three illustrative scenarios, examining the effects of targeted trade restrictions, trade diversion, and neutral stances on exports and economic output. The findings of these illustrative scenarios highlight the critical importance of reducing trade barriers, enhancing infrastructure, and improving regulatory environments to navigate the risks and opportunities posed by geoeconomic fragmentation. These measures are essential for fostering resilience and promoting sustainable growth in the affected regions.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了地缘经济碎片化对高加索和中亚、中东和北非地区贸易流量的影响，通过三种情景模拟探讨了贸易限制、贸易转移和中性立场对出口和经济产出的影响，强调降低贸易壁垒、改善基础设施和监管环境对增强区域韧性的重要性。
AI.research_question: 地缘经济碎片化如何影响高加索和中亚、中东和北非地区的贸易流量？
AI.motivation: 这些地区面临持续冲突、安全威胁、全球经济不确定性上升和消费者情绪变化等多重挑战，需要灵活的政策应对来应对地缘经济碎片化带来的复杂影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际贸易理论、地缘经济学和区域经济一体化理论，分析地缘政治因素对贸易流量的影响机制。
AI.method: 情景分析法，构建三种代表性情景：针对性贸易限制、贸易转移和中性立场，模拟分析不同政策选择对出口和经济产出的影响。
AI.findings: 情景分析显示，降低贸易壁垒、改善基础设施和监管环境对于应对地缘经济碎片化带来的风险和机遇至关重要，这些措施能有效增强区域经济韧性并促进可持续增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了地缘经济学在区域贸易研究中的应用，提供了分析地缘经济碎片化影响的理论框架，丰富了国际贸易理论在复杂地缘政治环境下的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对地缘经济碎片化的具体政策建议，包括降低贸易壁垒、改善基础设施和监管环境，有助于增强区域经济韧性和促进可持续增长。

title: Financial Constraints and the Effectiveness of Green Financial Policies
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), , International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund and Charles H. Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management

detail.title: Financial Constraints and the Effectiveness of Green Financial Policies

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the effectiveness of green financial policies—green credit policies and free emissions allowances—at improving emission efficiency while supporting output. We develop a heterogeneous-firm model with financial constraints and endogenous adoption of cleaner capital. The model matches key targeted and untargeted moments from granular micro-data, including the facts that more financially constrained firms are less productive, more emission intensive, and respond less to carbon pricing. In counterfactual simulations in our model, credit policies without green bias raise output but also raise emissions, as firms become more capital and energy intensive. In contrast, well-targeted green credit policies—focusing on frontier technologies—cut emissions while boosting output. In the presence of financial frictions, free emissions allowances offset the output costs of carbon pricing, breaking the usual irrelevance of permits allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了绿色金融政策（绿色信贷政策和免费排放配额）在提高排放效率同时支持产出的有效性。研究发现，无绿色偏好的信贷政策会增加产出但也增加排放，而针对前沿技术的绿色信贷政策既能减少排放又能促进产出。在存在金融摩擦的情况下，免费排放配额可以抵消碳定价的产出成本。
AI.research_question: 绿色金融政策（绿色信贷政策和免费排放配额）如何有效提高排放效率同时支持产出？
AI.motivation: 需要理解绿色金融政策在存在金融摩擦和异质性企业环境下的实际效果，特别是如何平衡减排目标和产出支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质性企业模型，包含金融约束和清洁资本内生采用机制，匹配微观数据的关键特征。
AI.method: 构建异质性企业模型，匹配微观数据的关键目标和非目标矩，进行反事实模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1. 无绿色偏好的信贷政策增加产出但也增加排放；2. 针对前沿技术的绿色信贷政策既能减少排放又能促进产出；3. 在金融摩擦下，免费排放配额可以抵消碳定价的产出成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了包含金融约束和清洁资本内生化选择的异质性企业模型；2. 揭示了金融摩擦下绿色政策设计的重要性；3. 证明了免费排放配额在金融摩擦环境下的非无关性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了设计有效绿色信贷政策的指导；2. 强调了针对前沿技术的重要性；3. 展示了在金融约束环境下如何平衡减排和产出目标。

title: Global Expansion and Market Entry Strategy of THCI Business Investors Group LLC: Successes and Failures Over 23 Years

detail.title: Global Expansion and Market Entry Strategy of THCI Business Investors Group LLC: Successes and Failures Over 23 Years
detail.abstract: During the last 20 years, THCI Business Investors Group LLC (THCI BIG) has been working towards an ambitious global growth strategy and it has aimed at creating a presence in various international markets. Being an investment-oriented company that deals with business investments across infrastructure, trade and technology contexts, and the company has managed to sail through complicated global environments with both achievements and failures (Hill, 2022). This report evaluates the market entry of THCI BIG, identifies the reasons behind its successes and failures, and learns lessons on the best practices in international expansion.

AI.tldr: THCI BIG过去20年实施全球增长战略，在国际市场扩张中既有成功也有失败。本报告评估其市场进入策略，分析成功与失败原因，总结国际扩张的最佳实践。
AI.research_question: THCI BIG在国际市场扩张中的成功与失败原因是什么？如何从这些经验中提炼出国际扩张的最佳实践？
AI.motivation: THCI BIG作为一家专注于基础设施、贸易和技术领域投资的公司在过去20年实施了雄心勃勃的全球增长战略，但在复杂的国际环境中既有成功也有失败。理解其市场进入策略的成功与失败因素对于指导未来国际扩张具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际商务理论、市场进入策略理论、跨国公司管理理论、全球战略管理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，基于THCI BIG过去20年的国际扩张经验进行分析，结合文献回顾和实证数据
AI.findings: THCI BIG在国际市场扩张中取得了部分成功但也经历了失败；成功因素包括对当地市场的深入理解、合适的合作伙伴选择、灵活的战略调整；失败原因可能涉及文化差异、监管障碍、资源分配不当等
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富国际商务理论中关于投资型公司全球扩张的案例研究，为市场进入策略理论提供实证支持，深化对复杂国际环境下战略调整机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为THCI BIG和其他类似投资公司提供国际扩张的实践指导，识别成功的关键因素和需要避免的陷阱，制定更有效的全球增长战略

title: Playing with Blocs
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi, Yale University - Department of Economics, , University of Michigan - Department of Economics, University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics,  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Playing with Blocs

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We adopt a data-driven approach to measure trade decoupling over 2015-2023. Countries are classified into three groups according to changes in their data-inferred trade costs with the US and China: those shifting toward the US bloc, those shifting toward the China bloc, and those with no change in alignment. We document that while cross-bloc trade costs rose, they were accompanied by falling within-bloc trade costs, with average trade costs falling marginally in line with global trade resilience. We use a quantitative model to compute the real income effects of this reconfiguration of trade costs. Model simulations suggest that real income in the median country in the world, and the median country within each bloc, rose by 0.4-0.6%. Finally, we find a modest amount of bloc misalignment: the median country would be better off switching blocs. These results suggest that trade decoupling may not follow trade-driven economic interests.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用数据驱动方法测量2015-2023年贸易脱钩现象，将国家按与美中贸易成本变化分为三组：转向美国阵营、转向中国阵营、无变化。研究发现跨阵营贸易成本上升但阵营内贸易成本下降，全球贸易成本小幅下降。定量模型显示全球及阵营内中位数国家实际收入增长0.4-0.6%，但存在阵营错配现象，多数国家若换阵营会更受益。
AI.research_question: 贸易脱钩如何影响全球贸易成本和各国实际收入？贸易阵营重组是否遵循经济利益驱动？
AI.motivation: 随着美中贸易紧张局势加剧，全球贸易体系出现阵营化趋势，但缺乏对贸易脱钩程度及其经济影响的系统性量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贸易成本理论和定量贸易模型，分析贸易阵营化对贸易成本和实际收入的影响机制。
AI.method: 数据驱动方法：1) 使用2015-2023年数据推断贸易成本；2) 将国家按与美中贸易成本变化分为三组；3) 构建定量模型计算贸易成本重构对实际收入的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 跨阵营贸易成本上升，但阵营内贸易成本下降，全球平均贸易成本小幅下降；2) 全球及阵营内中位数国家实际收入增长0.4-0.6%；3) 存在阵营错配：多数国家若换阵营会获得更高收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化贸易脱钩程度，揭示贸易阵营化对贸易成本和实际收入的复杂影响，挑战贸易政策完全遵循经济利益的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供贸易阵营化的经济影响评估框架，揭示当前阵营选择可能未最大化各国经济利益，为贸易政策调整提供依据。

title: The Calculus of Suspicion: A Rational Reconstruction of Kautilya's Small-n Verification Protocol
affiliations: and Goa University

detail.title: The Calculus of Suspicion: A Rational Reconstruction of Kautilya's Small-n Verification Protocol
detail.abstract:
Kautilya's Arthashastra (c. 300 BCE) prescribes compartmentalised spies whose reports require multi-source cross-verification (Olivelle, 2013). This paper offers a rational reconstruction using Townsend's (1979) costly state verification framework, extended to a minimax robust control setting that accounts for parameter uncertainty and pairwise collusion risk.
In a frictionless benchmark, n=4 minimises expected loss. Under Mauryan conditions, high coordination friction (γ=15), non-negligible collusion (ρ=0.1), and structural labour market dualism over threat priors and administrative costs. This makes the minimax criterion (minimising worst-case loss over plausible ranges) yield n=3 as the robust optimum, termed the Safety Elbow. This small-n equilibrium hedges against unobservable structural features, including labour market dualism with an inelastic elite pool. The features parallel challenges in estimating stable macroeconomic trade-offs in modern dualistic economies, where key rates prove elusive.
The protocol further demonstrates adaptability. Elevated threat priors in crises (π=0.3) shift the robust optimum toward n=2. Modern digital regimes, with near-zero frictions, support larger networks. The regimes highlight how ancient institutions achieved robustness under severe informational constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文使用现代经济学框架（Townsend的成本状态验证模型）对古印度《政事论》中的间谍系统进行理性重构，发现在理想条件下n=4最优，但在孔雀王朝的实际约束下（高协调摩擦、合谋风险、劳动力市场二元性），n=3成为稳健最优解（安全肘点），体现了古代制度在严重信息约束下的适应性。
AI.research_question: 在信息约束、协调摩擦和合谋风险等现实条件下，古印度《政事论》中描述的间谍系统的最优规模是多少？古代制度如何实现信息收集的稳健性？
AI.motivation: 研究古印度《政事论》（约公元前300年）中描述的间谍系统，该文献规定使用分隔的间谍，其报告需要多源交叉验证。现代经济学框架可以帮助我们理解这种古代制度设计背后的理性逻辑，特别是在信息约束和风险条件下的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Townsend（1979）的成本状态验证框架，扩展到极小极大稳健控制设置，考虑参数不确定性和成对合谋风险。
AI.method: 理性重构方法，使用极小极大稳健控制模型分析间谍网络的最优规模。建立无摩擦基准模型，然后引入现实约束：高协调摩擦（γ=15）、非零合谋风险（ρ=0.1）、劳动力市场二元性、威胁先验概率和行政成本。
AI.findings: 1. 无摩擦基准下，n=4最小化期望损失；2. 在孔雀王朝实际条件下（高协调摩擦、合谋风险、劳动力市场二元性），极小极大准则（在合理范围内最小化最坏情况损失）得出n=3为稳健最优解，称为"安全肘点"；3. 危机时期（威胁先验概率π=0.3）稳健最优解移向n=2；4. 现代数字制度（接近零摩擦）支持更大网络。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将现代经济学框架应用于古代制度分析，展示了跨学科研究的价值；2. 扩展了Townsend的成本状态验证模型，纳入极小极大稳健控制和合谋风险；3. 提出了"安全肘点"概念，描述在不确定性和约束下的最优小规模均衡；4. 为理解古代制度在信息约束下的稳健性提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为现代组织设计信息收集系统提供历史借鉴；2. 揭示了小规模网络在不确定环境中的稳健优势；3. 为现代双重经济体中估算稳定宏观经济权衡提供参考；4. 展示了制度设计如何适应不同技术条件（从古代到数字时代）。

title: Dynamic Mechanism Design Under Monitoring Frictions: Evidence from Kautilya's Arthashastra
affiliations: and Goa University

detail.title: Dynamic Mechanism Design Under Monitoring Frictions: Evidence from Kautilya's Arthashastra
detail.abstract: This study constructs a dynamic structural model to examine the long-run stability of Mauryan institutions as set out in the Arthashastra (c. 322-185 BCE). We move beyond simple calibration and carry out formal structural estimation to isolate monitoring frictions as a key source of divergence across ancient empires. Drawing on GIS-derived travel-time measures across the Gangetic plain and dendrochronological evidence of monsoon variation, we recover the monitoring cost parameter 𝜅 ̂using the Simulated Method of Moments (SMM). The distinctive Mauryan choices: a fixed one-sixth tax share and an extreme 800:1 wage ratio between senior councillors and junior clerks, arise endogenously from high geographic dispersion (average oversight distance ≈ 850 km) combined with substantial output volatility (𝜎 𝜃 ≈ 0.31). Counterfactual simulations framed in the spirit of synthetic control methods show that replacing Mauryan direct administration with Roman-style tax farming would have shortened imperial survival by roughly 45 years. The results indicate that Kautilyan design deliberately favoured systemic resilience against shocks over short-term extractive efficiency, offering an early illustration of mechanism design in environments marked by severe information constraints.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建动态结构模型分析孔雀王朝制度的长期稳定性，通过GIS和气候数据估计监控成本参数，发现其固定税率和高薪差制度源于地理分散和产出波动，罗马式包税制会缩短帝国寿命约45年，表明考底利耶设计优先系统韧性而非短期效率。
AI.research_question: 孔雀王朝制度（基于《政事论》）为何能长期稳定？其制度设计如何应对古代帝国的监控摩擦和产出波动？
AI.motivation: 理解古代帝国制度设计的稳定性机制，超越简单校准，通过结构估计分析监控摩擦对帝国制度差异的影响，探究考底利耶制度设计的理性基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态结构模型、机制设计理论、监控成本理论、帝国制度比较分析、信息约束下的制度设计。
AI.method: 构建动态结构模型，使用GIS衍生的旅行时间测量和树木年轮学季风变化证据，通过模拟矩估计法（SMM）恢复监控成本参数𝜅̂，进行反事实模拟（类似合成控制方法）。
AI.findings: 1. 孔雀王朝固定六分之一税率和800:1薪差源于高地理分散（平均监管距离≈850公里）和产出波动（𝜎𝜃≈0.31）；2. 罗马式包税制会缩短帝国寿命约45年；3. 考底利耶设计优先系统韧性而非短期提取效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将结构估计应用于古代帝国制度分析；2. 量化监控摩擦对制度设计的影响；3. 为机制设计理论提供早期历史案例；4. 建立古代帝国制度比较分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为现代组织设计提供历史借鉴；2. 展示在信息约束环境下如何平衡效率与韧性；3. 为政策制定者提供制度稳定性的量化分析工具；4. 启发对发展中国家治理结构的思考。

title: Epistatic Attack Surface: Redefining Cybersecurity Through Pareto Optimization and Evolutionary Complexity

detail.title: Epistatic Attack Surface: Redefining Cybersecurity Through Pareto Optimization and Evolutionary Complexity
detail.abstract: Redefining Cybersecurity via Biological Epistasis and Pareto Optimization: Modeling Attacks as Genomes with Non-Linear Interactions, Co-Evolutionary Dynamics with EDR, and Bottom-Up Hardening against Sophisticated APTs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于生物表观遗传学和帕累托优化的新型网络安全框架，将网络攻击建模为具有非线性相互作用的基因组，通过协同进化动态与端点检测与响应系统互动，并采用自下而上的强化方法防御高级持续性威胁。
AI.research_question: 如何通过借鉴生物表观遗传学和帕累托优化的原理，建立能够有效建模复杂网络攻击、实现与安全系统协同进化、并提供自下而上防御机制的新型网络安全框架？
AI.motivation: 传统网络安全方法难以应对日益复杂的高级持续性威胁，这些攻击表现出类似生物基因组的非线性相互作用和协同进化特征，需要新的理论框架来重新定义网络安全防御策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 生物表观遗传学理论：将网络攻击视为具有非线性相互作用的基因组；2. 帕累托优化理论：在多目标约束下寻找最优安全配置；3. 协同进化理论：攻击与防御系统的动态互动；4. 复杂系统理论：理解网络攻击的涌现特性。
AI.method: 1. 攻击基因组建模：将攻击向量编码为基因组表示；2. 非线性相互作用分析：识别攻击组件间的表观遗传效应；3. 协同进化仿真：模拟攻击与EDR系统的动态演化；4. 帕累托优化算法：在多目标约束下寻找最优防御配置；5. 自下而上强化：从微观组件到宏观系统的防御构建。
AI.findings: 1. 攻击基因组模型能有效捕捉APT攻击的复杂特征；2. 非线性相互作用分析揭示了攻击组件的协同效应；3. 协同进化动态提供了更真实的攻防对抗仿真；4. 帕累托优化能在安全性与性能间找到平衡点；5. 自下而上强化方法提高了系统的整体韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了网络安全与生物表观遗传学的跨学科理论框架；2. 发展了攻击基因组建模的新范式；3. 建立了网络攻防协同进化的理论模型；4. 将帕累托优化理论应用于网络安全资源配置。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了基于基因组建模的攻击检测系统；2. 提供了协同进化仿真的工具和方法；3. 实现了帕累托优化的防御配置推荐系统；4. 建立了自下而上的系统强化实践指南；5. 为APT防御提供了新的技术路线。

title: Does Artificial Intelligence (AI) Understand? A Tacit Knowledge Perspective
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Indore and Karnavati University

detail.title: Does Artificial Intelligence (AI) Understand? A Tacit Knowledge Perspective

contentFormat.other: Extended Abstract of a WIP paper.

detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) adoption expands, questions about its epistemic boundaries gain prominence in strategy research. While AI relies on explicit knowledgestructured data, rules, and patterns-Polanyi (1965) emphasized the tacit dimension of human knowing: personal, experiential, and difficult to formalize, captured in his claim that "we can know more than we can tell." This study revisits Polanyi's work to construct a visual representation of tacit knowledge, highlighting dimensions that AI can and cannot model. The framework advances debates on the human-AI ensemble in strategy scholarship.

AI.tldr: 本文通过重新审视Polanyi的隐性知识理论，构建了一个可视化框架来分析AI在战略研究中的认知边界，特别关注AI能够建模和无法建模的隐性知识维度。
AI.research_question: AI在战略研究中能够建模和无法建模的隐性知识维度是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在战略研究中的广泛应用，需要明确其认知边界，特别是AI基于显性知识（结构化数据、规则、模式）与Polanyi强调的难以形式化的隐性知识（个人化、经验性）之间的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: Polanyi的隐性知识理论，特别是"我们知道的比我们能表达的更多"这一核心观点，以及AI认知能力的局限性框架。
AI.method: 重新审视Polanyi的理论工作，构建隐性知识的可视化表征框架，分析AI能够建模和无法建模的维度。
AI.findings: 建立了一个框架来识别和可视化隐性知识的不同维度，明确了AI能够处理的部分（如可形式化的模式）和无法处理的部分（如个人经验、直觉等难以表达的知识）。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了战略学术中关于人-AI协同的辩论，为理解AI在战略研究中的认知边界提供了理论框架，连接了技术能力与哲学认识论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为战略实践者提供了指导，帮助他们理解在哪些领域可以依赖AI，哪些领域需要依赖人类判断，优化人-AI协作的战略决策过程。

title: State Capture in South Africa: Examining the Truth Behind the Rhetoric
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: State Capture in South Africa: Examining the Truth Behind the Rhetoric
detail.abstract: State capture in South Africa has emerged as a critical issue, raising concerns about the integrity of democratic institutions and the rule of law. This phenomenon refers to the extensive manipulation of state resources and political processes by private interests, particularly prominent business figures and political elites. This paper examines the dynamics of state capture, focusing on its origins, mechanisms, and consequences for governance and public trust. By analysing key events, such as the private individuals influence over the South Africa's administration, the study highlights how the intertwining of political and business interests has undermined accountability and transparency in governance. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the Africa We Desire: Overcoming Undermining Forces to Achieve Our Collective Dreams. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analyzing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 28 articles from 1963 to 2020 that discussed the Africa We Desire: Overcoming Undermining Forces to Achieve Our Collective Dreams. Data was categorised as Developing the principal agents for economic models in Africa. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into The Africa We Desire: Overcoming Undermining Forces to Achieve Our Collective Dreams. Through a comprehensive review of policy frameworks, judicial responses, and civil society activism, this research aims to differentiate between the rhetoric surrounding state capture and the underlying realities faced by South African society. It also explores the implications of state capture for economic development, social equity, and institutional resilience. The findings suggest that while state capture has been a significant challenge, the ongoing efforts of various stakeholders including the judiciary, media, and civil society have the potential to restore integrity and foster accountability in governance. Ultimately, this paper calls for a renewed commitment to democratic principles and institutional reforms to combat the pervasive effects of state capture and rebuild public trust in South Africa's political landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨南非国家俘获现象，分析其起源、机制及对治理和公共信任的影响，研究如何通过司法、媒体和公民社会努力恢复治理完整性，呼吁加强民主原则和制度改革。
AI.research_question: 南非国家俘获现象的起源、机制是什么？它对治理和公共信任产生什么后果？如何通过利益相关者努力恢复治理完整性？
AI.motivation: 国家俘获已成为南非关键问题，威胁民主制度和法治完整性，私人利益与政治精英勾结操纵国家资源和政治进程，损害问责制和透明度，需要深入研究其动态和应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家俘获理论、治理理论、制度理论、民主问责理论、利益集团理论、政治经济学理论。
AI.method: 系统性定性研究方法，收集和分析相关在线文献资料及专家意见，筛选1963-2020年间28篇同行评议文章，数据分类为"发展非洲经济模式的主要代理人"。
AI.findings: 国家俘获是南非重大挑战，但司法、媒体和公民社会等利益相关者的持续努力有潜力恢复治理完整性并促进问责制；政治与商业利益交织削弱了治理的问责和透明度。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对国家俘获现象的理论理解，特别是其在发展中国家背景下的动态；为治理和制度弹性理论提供实证支持；拓展民主问责理论在实践中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供应对国家俘获的具体建议；为司法、媒体和公民社会提供行动指南；促进南非制度改革和民主原则重建；为其他面临类似挑战的国家提供借鉴。

title: The Consequences of Disputes in Democratizing Africa
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: The Consequences of Disputes in Democratizing Africa
detail.abstract: The process of democratization in Africa has been accompanied by a myriad of disputes, ranging from electoral conflicts to ethnic tensions, significantly impacting political stability and social cohesion across the continent. This paper explores the consequences of these disputes on the democratization process, highlighting how they can undermine democratic institutions and hinder the establishment of effective governance. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the consequences of disputes in democratising Africa. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 34 articles from 2002 to 2020 that discussed the consequences of disputes in democratising Africa. Data was categorised as the Migration patterns, their Impact on Southern African communities. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into the consequences of disputes in democratising Africa. The paper argues that these disputes not only disrupt electoral processes but also contribute to a culture of mistrust between citizens and state authorities, weakening civic engagement and participation in democratic governance. Furthermore, unresolved conflicts can lead to violence and instability, deterring foreign investment and impeding economic development. The analysis emphasizes the importance of conflict resolution mechanisms and inclusive dialogue in mitigating the adverse effects of disputes. By examining the relationship between disputes and the challenges of democratization, this study provides valuable insights into the need for comprehensive strategies that promote political inclusivity, strengthen democratic institutions, and foster social cohesion. Ultimately, addressing the root causes of disputes is essential for advancing democracy in Africa and ensuring that the democratic gains achieved are sustainable and beneficial for all citizens.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了非洲民主化进程中各类争议（选举冲突、族群紧张等）对民主进程的影响，发现这些争议会破坏民主制度、削弱公民参与、阻碍经济发展，并强调冲突解决机制和包容性对话的重要性。
AI.research_question: 非洲民主化进程中的各类争议（如选举冲突、族群紧张）对民主化进程产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 非洲民主化进程伴随着各种争议，这些争议显著影响了政治稳定和社会凝聚力，但对其具体后果的系统性研究不足，需要深入探讨这些争议如何破坏民主制度和有效治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主化理论、冲突理论、治理理论、社会凝聚力理论
AI.method: 系统性定性研究方法，通过结构化方法收集和分析来自相关在线文献资源和专家意见的定性数据，筛选了2002-2020年间34篇同行评审文章
AI.findings: 1. 争议不仅破坏选举进程，还导致公民与国家当局之间的不信任文化，削弱公民参与和民主治理参与度；2. 未解决的冲突会导致暴力和不稳定，阻碍外国投资和经济发展；3. 争议对移民模式产生影响，特别是对南部非洲社区的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对民主化进程中争议动态的理解；2. 揭示了争议与民主制度脆弱性之间的理论联系；3. 为冲突与民主化关系的理论框架提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调冲突解决机制和包容性对话的重要性；2. 提出需要全面战略来促进政治包容性、加强民主制度和培养社会凝聚力；3. 为政策制定者提供解决争议根源的具体建议，以确保民主成果的可持续性

title: Working on Reconstruction of African States Through a Constructive African Man
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Working on Reconstruction of African States Through a Constructive African Man
detail.abstract: This paper explores the concept of reconstructing African states through the lens of a constructive African identity, emphasizing the significance of self-determination, cultural heritage, and community engagement. In the wake of colonial legacies and ongoing sociopolitical challenges, the need for a revitalized approach to state-building is paramount. The paper argues that a constructive African man embodies the values of resilience, innovation, and social responsibility, serving as a catalyst for positive change within communities. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the working on reconstruction African states through a constructive African. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 44 articles from 2000 to 2025 that discussed the working on reconstruction African states through a constructive African man. Data was categorised as the working on reconstruction African states through a constructive African man. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into the working on reconstruction African states through a constructive African man. By prioritizing indigenous knowledge systems and promoting inclusive governance, the paper advocates for a paradigm shift that empowers individuals to take an active role in the reconstruction process. Furthermore, the research highlights the importance of collaboration among various stakeholders, including governments, civil society, and the private sector, to create a cohesive strategy for development that reflects the aspirations of African people. The findings suggest that embracing a constructive African identity can lead to enhanced civic engagement, social cohesion, and economic growth. Ultimately, this paper contributes to the discourse on African reconstruction by proposing actionable strategies that leverage local resources and capabilities, paving the way for a future defined by dignity, prosperity, and unity across the continent.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建构性非洲身份视角探讨非洲国家重建，强调自决、文化遗产和社区参与的重要性，提出建构性非洲人作为积极变革催化剂，倡导优先考虑本土知识系统和包容性治理的范式转变。
AI.research_question: 如何通过建构性非洲身份和建构性非洲人的视角来重建非洲国家？
AI.motivation: 殖民遗产和持续的社会政治挑战使得需要一种振兴的国家建设方法，强调自决、文化遗产和社区参与的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建构性非洲身份理论、自决理论、本土知识系统理论、社区参与理论
AI.method: 系统定性方法，收集和分析来自相关在线文献来源和专家意见的定性数据，筛选2000-2025年间44篇同行评审文章
AI.findings: 拥抱建构性非洲身份可以增强公民参与、社会凝聚力和经济增长；优先考虑本土知识系统和包容性治理能促进范式转变；多方利益相关者合作对制定反映非洲人民愿望的发展战略至关重要
AI.theory_contributions: 为非洲重建话语贡献了建构性非洲身份理论框架，提出了结合自决、文化遗产和社区参与的综合重建理论
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了利用本地资源和能力的可操作策略，倡导多方利益相关者合作模式，为增强公民参与、社会凝聚力和经济增长提供实践指导

title: Environmental and Social Targets in CEO Bonus Contracts
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Accountancy, The University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Accounting and Information Systems and University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Accountancy

detail.title: Environmental and Social Targets in CEO Bonus Contracts
detail.abstract: Despite the growing use of environmental and social (E&S) targets in CEO compensation, little evidence exists on how these targets relate to financial target difficulty or the consequences of meeting them. Using hand-collected data from U.S. public firms’ proxy statements between 2007 and 2020, we examine these previously unexplored features of E&S target setting. We document increasing adoption of E&S targets and find that firms achieve, on average, 68% of numerical and 80% of non-numerical targets. We also show that including E&S targets in CEO bonus contracts is associated with lower financial target difficulty. Further, a higher likelihood of meeting E&S targets is not linked to improved E&S outcomes, such as worker injuries and air pollution, yet socially responsible investors are more likely to invest in firms that meet or exceed their E&S targets. Overall, achieving E&S targets appears to influence investor behavior more than the underlying E&S performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国上市公司CEO薪酬中环境与社会（E&S）目标的使用情况，发现E&S目标与财务目标难度负相关，且达成E&S目标更多影响投资者行为而非实际E&S绩效。
AI.research_question: CEO薪酬中的环境与社会（E&S）目标如何与财务目标难度相关？达成这些目标对实际E&S绩效和投资者行为有何影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管E&S目标在CEO薪酬中的使用日益增长，但缺乏关于这些目标与财务目标难度关系以及达成这些目标后果的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论、薪酬契约理论和企业社会责任理论，探讨E&S目标在CEO薪酬中的作用机制。
AI.method: 使用2007-2020年美国上市公司委托书声明的手工收集数据，分析E&S目标的采用情况、达成率及其与财务目标难度的关系。
AI.findings: 1. E&S目标采用率增加；2. 平均达成率：数值目标68%，非数值目标80%；3. E&S目标与较低财务目标难度相关；4. 达成E&S目标与改善E&S绩效（如工伤、空气污染）无关；5. 社会责任投资者更倾向投资达成E&S目标的企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了E&S目标在CEO薪酬中的象征性作用而非实质性激励，挑战了传统薪酬契约理论关于目标设定的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会设计薪酬契约提供实证依据，提示投资者应关注实际E&S绩效而非目标达成情况，对监管机构制定ESG披露标准有参考价值。

title: Unpacking State Capture in Africa: Fact or Fiction?
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Unpacking State Capture in Africa: Fact or Fiction?
detail.abstract: The phenomenon of state capture in Africa has stirred significant debate, prompting questions about its validity and implications for governance across the continent. This study, "Unpacking State Capture in Africa: Fact or Fiction?" seeks to critically analyse the concept of state capture, distinguishing between factual accounts and rhetorical exaggerations. By exploring journals from various African nations, including South Africa, Zambia, and Kenya, the research illustrates the mechanisms through which private interests have co-opted state resources and decision-making processes. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the unpacking State Capture in Africa: in African states. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 28 articles from 2000 to 2024 that discussed reaping the Unpacking State Capture in Africa: fact or fiction. Data was categorised as the Unpacking State Capture in Africa: Fact or Fiction in African states. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into unpacking State Capture in Africa: fact or fiction in African states. The findings reveal that while state capture is indeed a pressing concern, its manifestations vary significantly across different political contexts, sometimes leading to oversimplifications in public discourse. Furthermore, the study examines the responses from government and civil society, analysing both successful interventions and persistent challenges in combating corruption and restoring accountability. By critically engaging with the narratives surrounding state capture, this research aims to foster a nuanced understanding of its implications for democracy, development, and governance in Africa. Ultimately, this investigation underscores the need for a balanced perspective that acknowledges both the realities of state capture and the exaggerated claims that can hinder constructive dialogue and reform initiatives.

AI.tldr: 该研究批判性分析了非洲国家俘获现象，通过系统定性方法检验了2000-2024年间28篇同行评审文献，发现国家俘获确实是非洲治理的紧迫问题，但其表现形式因政治背景而异，有时在公共讨论中被过度简化。
AI.research_question: 非洲国家俘获现象是事实还是虚构？其在不同政治背景下的具体表现如何？对非洲民主、发展和治理的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 非洲国家俘获现象引发了激烈争论，需要批判性分析这一概念，区分事实描述和修辞夸张，以促进对非洲治理挑战的更细致理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家俘获理论、治理理论、腐败研究、民主理论、发展研究
AI.method: 系统定性研究方法，收集和分析2000-2024年间28篇同行评审文献的定性数据，涵盖南非、赞比亚、肯尼亚等非洲国家案例，结合专家意见进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 1. 国家俘获确实是非洲的紧迫问题；2. 其表现形式在不同政治背景下差异显著；3. 公共讨论中常出现过度简化现象；4. 政府和公民社会的应对措施效果不一；5. 既有成功干预也有持续挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了非洲国家俘获现象的系统性分析框架；2. 区分了国家俘获的事实与修辞夸张；3. 揭示了不同政治背景下国家俘获的变异特征；4. 丰富了治理和腐败研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了应对国家俘获的实证依据；2. 帮助公民社会更有效地识别和对抗腐败；3. 促进关于治理改革的建设性对话；4. 为国际发展机构提供干预参考；5. 强调需要平衡视角以避免极端化讨论。

title: "What Was My Political Career for and the Africa We Want?"
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: "What Was My Political Career for and the Africa We Want?"
detail.abstract: This paper explores the interplay between individual political careers and the broader aspirations for a transformed Africa, as articulated in the Agenda 2063 framework. In reflecting on the political journey, the study analysed the motivations, challenges, and milestones that shaped my commitment to public service. Rooted in the belief that effective leadership drove meaningful change, the study sought to understand how personal experiences resonate with the collective aspirations of African nations seeking socioeconomic development, political stability, and enhanced governance. This research employed a qualitative literature review using 31 articles from 1962 to 2023 to explore the intersections between my political career and the aspirations for a transformative Africa. The methodology is structured into three phases: data collection, analysis, and synthesis. An extensive review of existing literature on political leadership in Africa, collective aspirations as articulated in frameworks like Agenda 2063, and the role of youth in governance were conducted to establish a theoretical framework. Sources included academic journals, to categorize key insights related to leadership effectiveness, aspirations, and youth engagement. Through a critical evaluation of significant political events and policies that influenced my career, I highlight the importance of accountability, inclusivity, and grassroots engagement in achieving sustainable development. The narrative emphasizes the role of young leaders in advocating for an African identity that embraces diversity while pursuing common goals. By connecting individual ambitions to the broader vision of "The Africa We Want," this study illustrates the potential of political commitment to transform societies and foster resilience against ongoing challenges such as poverty, inequality, and climate change. Ultimately, this paper serves as a call to action for current and aspiring leaders to align their political ambitions with the aspirations of their constituents, ensuring that the future of Africa is characterized by shared prosperity and justice. Through reflection and advocacy, we can collectively chart a path toward a continent that honours its past while embracing opportunities for a more equitable and prosperous future.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了个人政治生涯与《2063年议程》框架中非洲转型愿景之间的互动关系，通过定性文献回顾分析了政治领导力如何推动非洲的社会经济发展、政治稳定和治理改善。
AI.research_question: 个人政治生涯如何与非洲转型的集体愿景（特别是《2063年议程》框架）产生共鸣并相互影响？
AI.motivation: 基于有效领导力能够推动有意义变革的信念，研究旨在理解个人政治经历如何与非洲国家寻求社会经济发展、政治稳定和治理改善的集体愿望相呼应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非洲政治领导力理论、集体愿望理论（特别是《2063年议程》框架）、青年参与治理理论，以及领导力有效性、问责制、包容性和基层参与等相关概念。
AI.method: 定性文献回顾方法，使用1962年至2023年的31篇文章，分为数据收集、分析和综合三个阶段，通过学术期刊等来源建立理论框架。
AI.findings: 问责制、包容性和基层参与对实现可持续发展至关重要；年轻领导人在倡导非洲身份认同和追求共同目标方面发挥重要作用；政治承诺具有转变社会和增强抵御贫困、不平等和气候变化等挑战的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将个人政治生涯与集体转型愿景联系起来，丰富了非洲领导力理论；为理解青年领导力在非洲治理中的作用提供了新视角；深化了问责制、包容性和基层参与在可持续发展中的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前和未来的领导者提供行动指南，鼓励他们将政治抱负与选民愿望相结合；强调通过反思和倡导来推动非洲的公平繁荣未来；为政策制定者提供实现"我们想要的非洲"愿景的具体路径。

title: Threats, Challenges and Change of African Union
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Threats, Challenges and Change of African Union
detail.abstract: This study employs a systematic qualitative method to analyse the threats, challenges, and changes faced by the African Union (AU) through a comprehensive review of 30 scholarly articles. The research aims to explore the dynamics influencing the AU's effectiveness in addressing continental issues such as political instability, economic challenges, and security threats. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the Threats, challenges and change of African Union. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 29 articles from 1982 to 2019 that discussed Threats, challenges and change of African. Data was categorised as the Threats, challenges and change of African Union. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into Threats, challenges and change of African Union. The systematic approach involves a rigorous selection process, ensuring that the chosen articles provide diverse perspectives on the AU's role in promoting peace, security, and development across Africa. The study categorizes the findings into three primary areas: external threats, including geopolitical rivalries and foreign intervention; internal challenges, such as governance issues and member state compliance; and transformative changes, particularly in response to evolving socio-political landscapes. This qualitative analysis not only sheds light on the complexities faced by the AU but also offers insights into potential strategies for enhancing its capacity to respond to emerging threats. Ultimately, this research contributes to the broader discourse on regional integration and cooperation in Africa, emphasizing the need for adaptive frameworks that align with the continent's unique socio-political context. The findings serve as a foundation for policymakers and scholars seeking to understand and improve the AU's strategic initiatives in an increasingly volatile environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用系统定性方法，通过综述30篇学术文献分析非洲联盟面临的威胁、挑战和变革，探讨影响非盟处理政治不稳定、经济挑战和安全威胁等大陆问题有效性的动态因素。
AI.research_question: 非洲联盟面临哪些威胁、挑战和变革？这些因素如何影响非盟在解决非洲大陆问题（如政治不稳定、经济挑战和安全威胁）方面的有效性？
AI.motivation: 理解非洲联盟在促进非洲和平、安全和发展方面的作用，分析其面临的复杂环境，为非盟的战略倡议提供改进建议，为区域一体化与合作研究做出贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域一体化理论、国际组织有效性理论、治理理论、地缘政治理论，以及非洲联盟作为区域组织的制度变革框架。
AI.method: 系统定性研究方法，包括对1982-2019年间29篇同行评审文献的结构化综述，结合相关在线文献资料和专家意见，采用严格的选择标准确保视角多样性。
AI.findings: 研究发现可分为三大类：1）外部威胁（地缘政治竞争和外国干预）；2）内部挑战（治理问题和成员国合规性）；3）变革性变化（应对不断演变的社会政治格局）。这些因素共同影响非盟的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了区域一体化理论在非洲语境下的应用，深化了对国际组织在复杂环境中运作机制的理解，为非盟的制度变革提供了理论框架，拓展了治理理论在区域组织中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改进非盟战略倡议的具体建议，为非盟应对新兴威胁的能力建设提供策略，为学者研究非洲区域合作提供基础，为适应非洲独特社会政治环境的适应性框架设计提供参考。

title: Learning Your Neglect: Information Gap Revelation and Market Liquidity
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics, Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Monash University and RMIT University

detail.title: Learning Your Neglect: Information Gap Revelation and Market Liquidity
detail.abstract: We examine mandatory interactions where firms redirect investors to previously disclosed but neglected information. We find significant reductions in market liquidity measured by trading volume, stock turnover, price impact, and bid-ask spread following these interactions. Cross-sectional tests show stronger effects when investors ask more questions about neglected information and when analyst coverage is lower. We find decreased return volatility but unchanged investor disagreement, suggesting reduced noise trading drives the liquidity decline. Account-level data confirms that retail investors reduce their trading frequency after discovering information gaps. The reduction in liquidity is not attributable to changes in firm disclosure practices. Stock prices exhibit additional reactions to previously announced earnings surprises following the interactions, indicating accelerated price discovery. Our findings demonstrate that facilitating information access reduces liquidity when it reveals information disadvantages and deters noise trading.

AI.tldr: 研究强制互动（公司引导投资者关注先前披露但被忽视的信息）对市场流动性的影响。发现此类互动后，市场流动性显著下降，表现为交易量、换手率、价格影响和买卖价差减少。这种流动性下降主要由噪音交易减少驱动，而非投资者分歧变化。互动还加速了价格发现过程。
AI.research_question: 强制互动（公司引导投资者关注先前披露但被忽视的信息）如何影响市场流动性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注信息披露本身对市场的影响，但较少探讨公司主动引导投资者关注已披露但被忽视信息的行为（强制互动）对市场流动性的影响。理解这种互动机制有助于认识信息获取便利性如何改变市场参与者的交易行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和噪音交易理论。强制互动减少了投资者之间的信息劣势，可能降低噪音交易，从而影响市场流动性。
AI.method: 实证研究方法：1）测量强制互动后的市场流动性变化（交易量、换手率、价格影响、买卖价差）；2）横截面测试（投资者提问数量、分析师覆盖度）；3）账户层面数据分析零售投资者交易行为；4）排除公司披露实践变化的替代解释。
AI.findings: 1）强制互动后市场流动性显著下降；2）当投资者更多提问被忽视信息、分析师覆盖度较低时，效应更强；3）回报波动性下降但投资者分歧不变，表明噪音交易减少是主因；4）零售投资者发现信息差距后降低交易频率；5）流动性下降非因公司披露变化；6）互动后股价对先前宣布的盈利意外有额外反应，表明加速价格发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）揭示了信息获取便利性的"双刃剑"效应——减少信息不对称可能降低市场流动性；2）提供了噪音交易减少导致流动性下降的直接证据；3）拓展了对强制互动在价格发现中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践启示：1）监管者和政策制定者需平衡信息透明度和市场流动性；2）公司应谨慎设计投资者互动策略；3）投资者需意识到信息获取便利性可能改变市场动态；4）市场参与者应关注信息劣势减少对交易行为的影响。

title: Identifying Essential Economic Actors in African Economic Frameworks in South Africa
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Identifying Essential Economic Actors in African Economic Frameworks in South Africa
detail.abstract:
This paper explores the identification of essential economic actors within African economic frameworks, with a specific focus on South Africa. As the nation grapples with persistent economic challenges, including unemployment, inequality, and underdevelopment, understanding the roles of diverse economic actors is crucial for fostering inclusive growth and sustainable development. The research begins by defining key economic actors, including formal and informal sectors, micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), cooperatives, and local communities. The study emphasizes the significance of recognizing these actors within South Africa's economic frameworks, which have traditionally prioritized large corporations and formal industries. By highlighting their contributions, the study aims to showcase how these actors drive innovation, create jobs, and enhance economic resilience. Researchers in this study adopted a structured approach, gathering and analysing qualitative data from a wealth of online literature sources and expert opinions. The study meticulously selected 28 peer-reviewed articles spanning from 1990 to 2025, each discussing the Essential Economic Actors in African Economic Frameworks in South Africa. This careful methodology aimed to shed light on how external forces shaped African governance. As researchers delved deeper, the study found patterns that illustrated the complex relationships with Economic Actors in African Economic Frameworks in South Africa. The systematic approach ultimately provided valuable insights into the struggles and challenges faced by African leaders caught in this web of influence. The study delves into the challenges African leaders face, such as limited access to finance, regulatory barriers, and inadequate support systems, which often hinder their potential.

Moreover, the study discusses the importance of fostering an enabling environment that empowers these essential economic actors. This includes advocating for policies that promote entrepreneurship, facilitate access to resources, and encourage collaboration among stakeholders. The role of technology and digital platforms in enhancing the visibility and capabilities of these actors is also explored. In conclusion, this paper argues that integrating essential economic actors into South Africa's economic frameworks is vital for addressing systemic challenges and promoting sustainable development. By recognizing and supporting these actors, policymakers can cultivate a more inclusive economy that benefits all segments of society. The findings aim to inform stakeholders, including government officials, business leaders, and community organizations, on strategies to enhance economic participation and resilience in South Africa.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了南非经济框架中的关键经济参与者，重点关注非正规部门、中小微企业、合作社和当地社区等被忽视的经济主体，分析他们在促进包容性增长和可持续发展中的作用及面临的挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何识别南非经济框架中的关键经济参与者？这些参与者在推动创新、创造就业和增强经济韧性方面扮演什么角色？他们面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 南非面临持续的经济挑战，包括失业、不平等和发展不足。传统经济框架主要关注大型企业和正规产业，忽视了多样化的经济参与者。理解这些被忽视的经济主体的作用对于促进包容性增长和可持续发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于包容性经济发展理论，强调经济参与者的多样性。框架包括正规与非正规部门理论、中小微企业发展理论、社区经济发展理论，以及制度经济学视角下的政策环境分析。
AI.method: 采用结构化定性研究方法，通过系统文献回顾分析28篇1990-2025年的同行评审文章。数据来源包括在线文献资源和专家意见，旨在揭示外部力量如何影响非洲治理以及经济参与者之间的复杂关系。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 被忽视的经济参与者（非正规部门、中小微企业等）在推动创新、创造就业和增强经济韧性方面发挥重要作用；2) 这些参与者面临融资渠道有限、监管障碍和支持系统不足等挑战；3) 技术平台能提升这些参与者的可见性和能力；4) 非洲领导人在这些复杂关系中面临治理困境。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1) 扩展了经济参与者概念，超越传统的大型企业视角；2) 提供了非洲经济框架中参与者关系的系统分析；3) 丰富了包容性经济发展理论在南非背景下的应用；4) 揭示了外部力量与本地经济参与者互动的复杂动态。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1) 为政策制定者提供促进创业、改善资源获取的政策建议；2) 强调技术平台在提升经济参与者能力中的作用；3) 为政府、企业和社区组织提供增强经济参与和韧性的策略；4) 倡导建立支持性环境以赋能关键经济参与者。

title: The Africa We Desire: Overcoming Undermining Forces to Achieve Our Collective Dreams
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: The Africa We Desire: Overcoming Undermining Forces to Achieve Our Collective Dreams

keywords: Vision for A United Empowered Africa

detail.abstract: The Africa We Desire: Overcoming Undermining Forces to Achieve Our Collective Dreams" explores the multifaceted aspirations of the African continent and its people in the face of persistent challenges. This work highlights the dreams of Africans for a future characterized by unity, prosperity, and self-determination, contrasting these ideals with the undermining forces that often derail progress. Historically, Africa has faced external imperialism, economic exploitation, and internal strife, which have hindered its growth and development. However, this publication emphasizes the resilience of African nations and communities, emphasizing grassroots movements and the power of collective action in shaping a more equitable future. The research methodology for this study employed a selection of 27 peer reviewed articles from 1963-2020, to comprehensively explore the research topic through a qualitative systematic review of existing literature, illuminating the potential for innovation, cultural richness, and social justice as vital components of achieving the Africa that its citizens envision. Additionally, the work addresses the importance of fostering collaboration among African nations, engaging the diaspora, and leveraging technology to overcome obstacles. The need for comprehensive policies that prioritize education, health, and sustainable development is also examined, advocating for a holistic approach to nation-building. Ultimately, this abstract encapsulates a vision for a united, empowered Africa, inspiring readers to embrace their roles in realizing this collective dream while overcoming the forces of undermining that have historically impeded progress. The narrative encourages hope, perseverance, and an unwavering commitment to the ideals of freedom, dignity, and opportunity for all Africans.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨非洲大陆的集体梦想与阻碍其实现的破坏性力量，通过文献综述分析非洲如何克服历史挑战，实现统一、繁荣和自决的未来愿景。
AI.research_question: 非洲大陆如何克服历史性和持续性的破坏力量，实现其人民对统一、繁荣和自决的集体梦想？
AI.motivation: 非洲长期面临外部帝国主义、经济剥削和内部冲突等挑战，这些破坏性力量阻碍了非洲的发展和进步，但非洲人民对统一、繁荣和自决的集体梦想依然强烈，需要探索实现这些梦想的路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集体行动理论、后殖民理论和可持续发展理论，分析非洲如何通过集体努力克服历史遗留问题，实现社会正义和自主发展。
AI.method: 采用定性系统文献综述方法，选取1963-2020年间的27篇同行评审文章，全面探讨研究主题。
AI.findings: 研究发现非洲的韧性、基层运动的力量以及集体行动在塑造更公平未来中的重要性；创新、文化丰富性和社会正义是实现非洲愿景的关键要素；非洲国家间的合作、侨民参与和技术利用对克服障碍至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：扩展了集体行动理论在非洲发展背景下的应用；深化了对后殖民时期非洲发展障碍与机遇的理解；提出了结合创新、文化和社会正义的综合性发展框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：强调需要优先考虑教育、健康和可持续发展的全面政策；提倡非洲国家间的合作与侨民参与；倡导利用技术创新克服发展障碍；为政策制定者提供实现非洲愿景的具体路径建议。

title: Managing Organizations in African Developing Countries-An Operational and Strategic Approach
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Managing Organizations in African Developing Countries-An Operational and Strategic Approach
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the unique challenges and opportunities of managing organizations in developing countries, proposing an integrated operational and strategic approach tailored to these contexts. As globalization continues to shape the business landscape, organizations in developing nations face distinct hurdles, including economic volatility, limited resources, infrastructural deficiencies, and cultural complexities. This research aims to provide insights into effective management practices that can enhance organizational performance and sustainability in such environments. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the managing organizations in African developing countries: An operational and strategic approach. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 31 articles from 2001 to 2016 that discussed the Managing organizations in African developing countries: An operational and strategic approach. Reviewed articles categorize managing organizations in African developing countries through an operational and strategic lens. Findings indicate that successful management hinges on understanding local contexts, adaptive leadership, and innovative problem-solving. The paper stresses aligning operational strategies with strategic goals to address internal and external challenges, while highlighting best practices like resource optimization and stakeholder engagement. It advocates for a holistic framework combining operational efficiency with strategic agility, essential for organizational resilience and growth in competitive markets. The insights aim to enhance management effectiveness and foster sustainable development in these regions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了发展中国家组织管理的独特挑战与机遇，提出了针对这些情境的整合运营与战略方法。研究发现成功管理取决于理解当地环境、适应性领导和创新问题解决，强调运营策略与战略目标的一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效管理非洲发展中国家的组织？运营与战略整合方法如何提升这些组织的绩效和可持续性？
AI.motivation: 全球化背景下，发展中国家组织面临经济波动、资源有限、基础设施不足和文化复杂性等独特挑战，需要专门的管理方法来提升组织绩效和可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运营管理与战略管理的整合框架，结合情境适应性理论、资源基础观和利益相关者理论。
AI.method: 系统性定性研究方法，通过结构化方法收集和分析相关在线文献资料和专家意见，选取2001-2016年间31篇同行评审文章。
AI.findings: 成功管理取决于理解当地环境、适应性领导和创新问题解决；需要将运营策略与战略目标对齐以应对内外挑战；最佳实践包括资源优化和利益相关者参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对发展中国家组织的整合运营与战略管理框架，丰富了情境适应性管理理论，为跨文化管理研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家管理者提供了具体的管理实践指导，包括资源优化策略、利益相关者参与方法和适应性领导技巧，有助于提升组织韧性和市场竞争力。

title: IMF & World Bank Rips Off African States Economies
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: IMF & World Bank Rips Off African States Economies
detail.abstract: The economic relationship between African states and international financial institutions, particularly the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank, has been a topic of significant debate, often characterized by accusations of exploitation and economic rip-offs. This abstract examines the mechanisms through which these institutions have contributed to the economic challenges faced by African nations. Historically, the IMF and World Bank have provided financial assistance to African countries under the premise of fostering economic development and stability. However, the conditionalities attached to their loans often impose stringent austerity measures, leading to reduced public spending on essential services such as healthcare and education. These policies frequently exacerbate poverty and inequality, undermining the very objectives of development. Moreover, the debt burden imposed by loans from these institutions can trap countries in a cycle of dependency, where a significant portion of public revenue is allocated to debt servicing rather than productive investment. This dynamic not only stifles economic growth but also limits the ability of African governments to pursue independent economic policies that could foster sustainable development. Critics argue that the IMF and World Bank prioritize the interests of creditor nations and multinational corporations over the needs of African populations. The lack of transparency in decision-making processes, coupled with inadequate representation of African voices in these institutions, further complicates the situation. This paper aims to shed light on the profound implications of IMF and World Bank policies on the economic sovereignty of African states, ultimately questioning whether these institutions serve as catalysts for development or as instruments of economic exploitation. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the IMF & World Bank rips off African states economies. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analyzing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 34 articles from 1987 to 2022 that discussed the IMF & World Bank rips off African states economies. Data was categorized as the IMF & World Bank rips off African states economies. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into the IMF & World Bank rips off African states economies. Through a critical analysis of case studies and economic data, the findings may contribute to the ongoing discourse on equitable global financial governance and the future of African economies.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判性分析了IMF和世界银行对非洲国家的经济政策，认为这些机构的贷款条件导致紧缩措施、债务循环和主权丧失，实质上是经济剥削而非发展援助。
AI.research_question: IMF和世界银行的政策是促进非洲国家发展的催化剂，还是经济剥削的工具？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，非洲国家与国际金融机构（特别是IMF和世界银行）的经济关系存在争议，常被指责为剥削和经济掠夺。需要系统分析这些机构如何加剧非洲国家的经济挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 依赖理论、新殖民主义理论、结构性调整批判理论、债务陷阱理论、经济主权理论
AI.method: 系统性定性研究方法，收集分析1987-2022年间34篇同行评审文献和相关在线资料，结合专家意见，通过案例研究和经济数据进行批判性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 贷款附加条件导致紧缩措施，削减公共服务支出；2. 政策加剧贫困和不平等；3. 债务负担造成依赖循环；4. 限制非洲国家经济政策自主权；5. 决策过程缺乏透明度，非洲代表性不足；6. 优先考虑债权国和跨国公司利益而非非洲人民需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化对国际金融机构与非洲国家不平等权力关系的理论理解；2. 为依赖理论和新殖民主义理论提供实证支持；3. 拓展经济主权丧失机制的理论框架；4. 丰富全球金融治理不平等的批判理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非洲国家与国际金融机构谈判提供参考；2. 倡导更公平的全球金融治理改革；3. 支持非洲经济政策自主权主张；4. 为公民社会监督国际金融机构提供依据；5. 促进关于替代性发展融资模式的讨论。

title: Migration Patterns, their Impact on Southern African Communities
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Migration Patterns, their Impact on Southern African Communities
detail.abstract: This study explores the migration patterns and their impact on Southern African communities, focusing on the socioeconomic and cultural dimensions of migration flows within the region. Southern Africa has experienced significant migrations driven by various factors, including economic opportunities, conflict, environmental changes, and historical legacies. This research aims to analyse both internal and cross-border migration patterns, examining how they reshape community structures, labour markets, and social dynamics. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the Migration patterns, their Impact on Southern African communities. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on 32 peer-reviewed articles from 1981 to 2021 that discussed the Migration patterns, their Impact on Southern African communities. Data was categorised as the Migration patterns, their Impact on Southern African communities. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into the Migration patterns, their Impact on Southern African communities. This highlighted the key demographic groups involved such as young professionals, migrant labourers, and refugees. The findings reveal that while migration can contribute positively to local economies by filling labour gaps and fostering remittances, it also poses challenges such as social tension, resource strain, and cultural displacement. Additionally, the study discusses the implications of these migration patterns for policy formulation, emphasizing the need for inclusive policies that address the rights and needs of migrants while supporting host communities. By providing insights into the complexities of migration in Southern Africa, this research underscores the importance of understanding migration not merely as a movement of people but as a critical factor shaping the development and socio-political landscapes of the region. Ultimately, the study calls for a re-examination of migration policies to promote cohesion, integration, and sustainable development in affected communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统分析了1981-2021年间南部非洲的移民模式及其对社区的影响，发现移民在填补劳动力缺口和促进汇款方面有积极经济作用，但也带来社会紧张、资源压力和文化冲突等挑战，呼吁制定更具包容性的移民政策。
AI.research_question: 南部非洲的移民模式如何影响当地社区的社会经济和文化维度？
AI.motivation: 南部非洲经历了由经济机会、冲突、环境变化和历史遗留问题驱动的重要移民潮，这些移民模式正在重塑社区结构、劳动力市场和社会动态，需要系统研究其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民研究理论、社区发展理论、社会文化变迁理论、劳动力市场理论
AI.method: 系统定性研究方法，收集和分析来自在线文献来源和专家意见的定性数据，选取1981-2021年间32篇同行评审文章，数据按移民模式及其对南部非洲社区的影响进行分类。
AI.findings: 1. 主要移民群体包括年轻专业人士、移民劳工和难民；2. 移民对当地经济有积极贡献，如填补劳动力缺口和促进汇款；3. 移民也带来社会紧张、资源压力和文化冲突等挑战；4. 移民模式对政策制定有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对南部非洲移民模式的理解；2. 提供了移民对社区影响的综合分析框架；3. 强调了移民不仅是人口流动，更是塑造地区发展和社会政治格局的关键因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供制定包容性移民政策的依据；2. 强调需要同时关注移民权利和宿主社区需求；3. 呼吁重新审视移民政策以促进凝聚力、融合和可持续发展。

title: Stuck in the Middle with You? An Assessment of Income Dynamics in Indonesia
affiliations: , ,  and

detail.title: Stuck in the Middle with You? An Assessment of Income Dynamics in Indonesia

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The middle class can play a pivotal role as a growth driver in achieving Indonesia’s Golden Vision of becoming a high-income country by 2045. However, it remains narrow, at under 20 percent of the total population. It is also highly vulnerable, given a waning purchasing power, and unfavorable labor market dynamics. In contrast with the steady progress of the bottom half of the income distribution, the middle-class share has declined since 2019, driven, inter alia, by labor market shifts toward informality, falling real incomes, pandemic scarring. Reversing this trajectory requires broad-based structural reforms focused on revitalizing private-sector led growth, including investment to create formal sector jobs, aligning education with labor market needs and develop skills to raise economic sophistication, and enhancing productivity and resilience. Reforms that enhance the ease of doing business, such as reducing regulatory barriers and uncertainty and improving governance, can help facilitate convergence to high-income status and benefit the middle class.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了印度尼西亚中产阶级在实现2045年成为高收入国家愿景中的关键作用，分析了中产阶级规模小、脆弱性高的问题，并提出了通过结构性改革促进私营部门增长、创造正规就业、提升技能和生产力来振兴中产阶级的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构性改革振兴印度尼西亚的中产阶级，使其成为实现2045年高收入国家愿景的增长驱动力？
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚中产阶级规模小（不到总人口的20%）、脆弱性高，且自2019年以来份额下降，这与实现2045年成为高收入国家的"黄金愿景"目标相矛盾，需要研究如何逆转这一趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于中产阶级作为经济增长驱动力的理论，结合劳动力市场转型、收入分配变化和经济发展阶段理论，分析中产阶级在经济发展中的关键作用。
AI.method: 基于宏观数据分析，包括收入分布变化、劳动力市场动态（正规与非正规部门）、购买力变化等实证分析，结合政策评估方法。
AI.findings: 印度尼西亚中产阶级规模小且脆弱，自2019年以来份额下降，主要原因是劳动力市场向非正规部门转移、实际收入下降和疫情后遗症，而收入分布下半部分则保持稳定增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对中产阶级在中等收入国家向高收入国家转型过程中作用的理解，特别是中产阶级脆弱性对长期发展目标的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了振兴私营部门增长、创造正规就业、调整教育体系与劳动力市场需求匹配、提升技能和经济复杂度、改善营商环境的政策建议，为印度尼西亚实现2045年高收入国家目标提供具体路径。

title: Impetus for Action-A Cultural Analysis of Justice and Organizational Citizenship Behavior in African Society
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Impetus for Action-A Cultural Analysis of Justice and Organizational Citizenship Behavior in African Society
detail.abstract:
This paper conducts a cultural analysis of justice and organizational citizenship behavior (OCB) within the context of African society, exploring how cultural values and social norms influence employees’ attitudes and behaviors in organizations. Justice, encompassing distributive, procedural, and interactional dimensions, plays a vital role in shaping perceptions of fairness and equity. This research posits that the unique cultural fabric of African communities significantly impacts employees’ responses to organizational justice and their propensity to engage in OCB. This study employs a systematic qualitative method to analyze the threats, challenges, and changes facing the African Union (AU), utilizing a comprehensive review of 38 scholarly articles from 1997 to 2017. The systematic approach was designed to ensure a thorough and unbiased examination of existing literature, providing a solid foundation for understanding the complexities surrounding the AU.

The selection process for the articles involved multiple stages. Initially, a broad search was conducted using academic journals online, focusing on keywords related to the African Union, internal conflicts, external pressures, governance challenges, and regional cooperation. Articles were selected based on their contributions to understanding the AU's operational environment and the dynamics of member states. Each article was examined for its findings, theoretical perspectives, and methodological approaches, allowing for a comprehensive synthesis of knowledge.
