title: Northern InSights: Geopolitical Risk from Finnish News Media
affiliations: Bank of Finland, Bank of Finland - Institute for Economies in Transition (BOFIT), Bank of Finland - Research, Bank of Finland, Bank of Finland - Institute for Economies in Transition (BOFIT) and Bank of Finland

detail.title: Northern InSights: Geopolitical Risk from Finnish News Media

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 13/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We construct a geopolitical risk indicator for Finland using local, Finnish language news media - FinnGPR. We compare FinnGPR to global and country-specific measures of geopolitical risk derived from Anglo-Saxon media. We show that in the case of Finland, local geopolitical risk perceptions based on local news media differ from global attention on geopolitical risk in Finland as reflected in the global media. We study the effects of FinnGPR on the Finnish economy and find that the Finnish economy tends to be resilient to geopolitical risk shocks. Nevertheless, we find that geopolitical risks can represent a threat to Finnish financial market stability.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了基于芬兰本地新闻媒体的地缘政治风险指标FinnGPR，发现芬兰本地与全球媒体对地缘政治风险的关注存在差异，芬兰经济对地缘政治风险冲击具有韧性，但金融稳定可能受到威胁。
AI.research_question: 芬兰本地媒体反映的地缘政治风险与全球媒体关注的地缘政治风险有何差异？这些风险对芬兰经济和金融稳定有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有地缘政治风险指标主要基于英美媒体，可能无法准确反映芬兰本地的风险感知。需要构建基于本地媒体的指标来更好理解芬兰面临的地缘政治风险及其经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险理论、媒体议程设置理论、风险感知理论、宏观经济冲击理论、金融稳定理论
AI.method: 构建基于芬兰语本地新闻媒体的地缘政治风险指标FinnGPR，与基于英美媒体的全球和国别指标进行对比分析，使用计量经济学方法研究FinnGPR对芬兰经济和金融市场的影响
AI.findings: 1) 芬兰本地媒体反映的地缘政治风险感知与全球媒体关注存在差异；2) 芬兰经济对地缘政治风险冲击表现出韧性；3) 地缘政治风险可能威胁芬兰金融市场的稳定性
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了基于本地媒体的地缘政治风险测量方法；2) 揭示了媒体来源对风险感知测量的重要性；3) 丰富了小国开放经济体对地缘政治风险反应的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为芬兰政策制定者提供了更准确的地缘政治风险监测工具；2) 帮助投资者更好评估芬兰市场风险；3) 为其他国家构建本地化风险指标提供了方法参考

title: Evaluation of an Innovative “Emergency Department Surge” Program for the Care and Treatment of Patients with Low-Acuity Conditions

detail.title: Evaluation of an Innovative “Emergency Department Surge” Program for the Care and Treatment of Patients with Low-Acuity Conditions
detail.abstract: Background: Emergency Department (ED) crowding negatively impacts healthcare. Numerous strategies have been created to improve treatment of low-acuity conditions to reduce ED crowding.Methods: We evaluated a novel “ED Surge” program within our institution’s Care Transition Clinic (CTC) which triages patients with lower-acuity conditions from the ED to our same-day on-site ambulatory CTC on future ED and hospital utilization. Demographics, visit characteristics, and clinical outcomes were evaluated. Bivariate and multivariate analyses assessed associations between patient, visit, and outcome characteristics. Significance was defined as p<0.05.Results: The ED Surge program saw 727 unique patients and 762 scheduled visits with 76% completion across 31 months of operation. Patients were significantly younger (p<0.01) and insured with Medicaid (p<0.01) than the general ED population. This population also experienced a significant decrease in 30-day post-appointment ED utilization (0.08 post- versus 0.2 pre- mean visits, p=0.01) than those who did not complete an appointment. We also identified several diagnoses that may be better served in the ED as opposed to the ambulatory setting.Conclusions: Innovative clinics such as our “ED Surge” program held within ambulatory care sites such as the CTC can be a useful tool to impact future ED utilization of patients with low-acuity conditions. Care should be taken to design the clinic to an ED’s specific population needs (such as underserved patient groups) and refine it according to how the clinic’s patient outcomes develop to optimize patient care and safety.

AI.tldr: ED Surge项目将低危患者从急诊科转诊至当日门诊诊所，显著降低了30天内急诊再就诊率，但需根据特定患者群体需求优化设计。
AI.research_question: ED Surge项目（将低危患者从急诊科转诊至当日门诊诊所）对患者未来急诊和住院使用率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 急诊科拥挤对医疗保健产生负面影响，需要创新策略来改善低危患者的治疗，减少急诊拥挤。
AI.theoretical_framework: 急诊分流理论、门诊护理替代模型、医疗资源优化配置理论。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，评估ED Surge项目31个月的数据，包括727名独特患者和762次预约。使用双变量和多变量分析评估患者、就诊和结果特征之间的关联，显著性定义为p<0.05。
AI.findings: 1. 项目完成率为76%；2. 患者比一般急诊人群更年轻且更多使用医疗补助保险；3. 完成预约的患者30天内急诊使用率显著降低（0.08次 vs 0.2次）；4. 识别出某些诊断可能更适合在急诊而非门诊处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了急诊分流至门诊诊所的可行性模型；2. 提供了针对特定患者群体（年轻、医疗补助患者）的分流策略证据；3. 识别了门诊护理的局限性边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医疗机构实施类似分流项目提供操作框架；2. 帮助优化急诊资源分配；3. 为政策制定者提供减少急诊拥挤的实际解决方案；4. 强调需要根据当地患者群体特征定制项目设计。

title: Waiting time interpretations: Complexity and consequences for radiotherapy delays
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Waiting time interpretations: Complexity and consequences for radiotherapy delays
detail.abstract: Background and purpose: Escalating waiting times in radiotherapy (RT) is a reoccurring problem, but delays are reported in multiple ways making it difficult to compare numbers internationally and locally. The purpose of this study is to increase the understanding of how different waiting time definitions impact delay calculations for various-sized RT departments with multiple diagnosis profiles.Materials and methods: We used recent 12-month scheduling data from a large Swedish RT department and compared diagnosis-specific delay distributions. Waiting time was quantified using referral and two preferred start dates (first and second). Delay was defined as total days exceeding the respective reference date. A descriptive approach was employed to illustrate diagnosis effects by waiting time definitions. We also included national data to incorporate perspectives from other RT departments.Results: The scheduling data included 4172 patients. With referral as reference, there was a median delay of 30 days across all patient groups. For the first preferred date, the average delay was 12 days, 3801 (91%) of patients started after this date. For the second preferred date, the average delay was 7 days, 1566 (38%) patients started after this date. Delays varied depending on diagnosis and booking category. National data showed that out of 14 departments, five used the referral date and eight departments used preferred dates.Conclusion: Overall, comparisons suggest focusing on preferred start dates for a better understanding of patient timelines. Referral to RT start as a definition could still be useful for patients with no other procedures before RT.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析瑞典放疗部门数据，发现不同的等待时间定义（转诊日期vs首选开始日期）对延迟计算结果有显著影响，建议关注首选开始日期以更好理解患者时间线。
AI.research_question: 不同的等待时间定义如何影响放疗延迟计算？
AI.motivation: 放疗等待时间不断延长是反复出现的问题，但延迟报告方式多样，难以进行国际和本地比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 等待时间测量理论，医疗服务质量评估框架
AI.method: 使用瑞典大型放疗部门12个月排程数据，比较诊断特异性延迟分布；采用转诊日期和两个首选开始日期作为参考点；纳入国家数据以获得其他部门的视角
AI.findings: 1) 以转诊为参考，所有患者组中位延迟30天；2) 以首选开始日期为参考，平均延迟12天，91%患者在此日期后开始治疗；3) 以第二首选日期为参考，平均延迟7天，38%患者在此日期后开始治疗；4) 延迟因诊断和预约类别而异；5) 国家数据显示14个部门中5个使用转诊日期，8个使用首选日期
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了等待时间测量方法的实证比较，揭示了不同定义对延迟计算结果的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 建议放疗部门关注首选开始日期以获得更准确的延迟评估；转诊到放疗开始的定义仍适用于放疗前无其他程序的患者；为国际比较提供了方法学参考

title: Music Metadata as a Fundamental-Rights Question, or EU’s Positive Obligations to Secure Cultural Visibility and Equality Online

detail.title: Music Metadata as a Fundamental-Rights Question, or EU’s Positive Obligations to Secure Cultural Visibility and Equality Online
detail.abstract: Music metadata – credits, identifiers, language labels, territorial tags, and genre descriptors – functions as the operative infrastructure of streaming. It shapes what becomes searchable, recommendable, charted, and remunerated. This chapter argues that metadata is therefore not a neutral technical resource but a constitutional site where structural inequality is produced or mitigated. When metadata is sparse, standardised around dominant markets, or mis-specified, the resulting visibility and remuneration deficits disproportionately affect minority-language repertoires, music from smaller territories, field recordings and traditional archives, and women and non-binary creators. The chapter situates these “structural metadata harms” within the EU’s fundamental-rights framework, contending that Article 22 CFR (respect for cultural and linguistic diversity), read together with Articles 13 (artistic freedom), 17(2) (intellectual property), 21 (non-discrimination), and 23 (gender equality), constrains and guides metadata governance. Drawing on CJEU rights-balancing and ECtHR doctrines of positive obligations and indirect discrimination (via Article 52(3) CFR), it develops the claim that EU regulatory and standard-setting choices must secure the practical and effective enjoyment of cultural visibility and equal rights-realisation online.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨音乐元数据作为流媒体基础设施如何影响文化可见性和报酬分配，指出元数据不足或偏差会导致结构性不平等，特别是对少数语言、小地区、传统档案及女性/非二元创作者的影响。文章基于欧盟基本权利框架，主张元数据治理应保障文化多样性和平等权利。
AI.research_question: 音乐元数据作为流媒体基础设施如何影响文化可见性和报酬分配？欧盟基本权利框架如何约束和指导元数据治理以解决结构性不平等问题？
AI.motivation: 音乐元数据通常被视为中性技术资源，但实际上它塑造了搜索、推荐、榜单和报酬分配。当元数据稀疏、标准化围绕主导市场或错误指定时，会导致少数语言曲目、小地区音乐、传统档案及女性/非二元创作者在可见性和报酬方面受到不成比例的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟基本权利框架（CFR），特别是第22条（尊重文化和语言多样性）、第13条（艺术自由）、第17(2)条（知识产权）、第21条（非歧视）和第23条（性别平等）。结合CJEU权利平衡原则和ECtHR关于积极义务及间接歧视的学说（通过CFR第52(3)条）。
AI.method: 法律分析和理论论证，基于欧盟基本权利框架和欧洲法院判例法，探讨元数据治理如何影响文化权利和平等权利的实际实现。
AI.findings: 元数据不足或偏差会导致"结构性元数据损害"，对少数群体创作者造成可见性和报酬赤字。欧盟基本权利框架为元数据治理提供了约束和指导，要求确保文化多样性和平等权利在网络环境中的实际有效实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将元数据概念化为非中性技术资源，而是结构性不平等产生或缓解的宪法性场所。发展了"结构性元数据损害"概念，并将其置于欧盟基本权利框架下进行分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟监管和标准制定提供指导，要求元数据治理必须保障文化可见性和平等权利的实际有效实现。为政策制定者、平台运营商和标准制定机构提供了基于权利的分析框架。

title: The Impact of The Financial and Non-Financial Aspects of Employees ’Rewards
affiliations: NATIONAL ELECTRONIC MEDIA INSTITUTE OF SOUTH AFRICA

detail.title: The Impact of The Financial and Non-Financial Aspects of Employees ’Rewards
detail.abstract:
This research proposal investigates the impact of both financial (extrinsic) and non-financial (intrinsic) reward systems on employees within a South African public higher learning institution. Despite the critical role that reward strategies play in attracting, retaining, and motivating talent to sustain competitive advantage, there remains a lack of conclusive empirical evidence on their specific effects in the South African context. The study is motivated by the need to help organizations balance and understand which reward components effectively enhance employee performance, engagement, motivation, creativity, and innovation.

Adopting a mixed-methods research paradigm, the study will employ a descriptive research design. Data will be collected concurrently through cross-sectional surveys distributed to employees and structured one-on-one interviews. A simple random sampling technique will be used to ensure representativeness. Primary data will be analyzed using both statistical methods (via SPSS) for quantitative data and interpretative approaches for qualitative data.

The research aims to determine the comprehensive impact of reward systems by addressing four key objectives: (1) analyzing the influence of rewards on employee creativity, innovation, engagement, motivation, and performance; (2) developing an appropriate instrument for empirical data collection; (3) evaluating and interpreting findings in light of existing literature; and (4) providing practical recommendations for aligning and implementing effective reward strategies in the specified setting.

The study anticipates contributing significant new knowledge to both theoretical discourse and organizational practice. For theory, it will offer contemporary empirical evidence on reward systems. For practice, it will provide actionable insights for human resource management, policymakers, and institutional leadership to design reward systems that are equitable, motivating, and strategically aligned with organizational goals, thereby addressing challenges related to employee turnover, satisfaction, and performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨南非公立高等教育机构中财务（外在）与非财务（内在）奖励系统对员工的影响，采用混合方法研究设计，旨在为组织提供有效的奖励策略建议。
AI.research_question: 财务（外在）和非财务（内在）奖励系统如何影响南非公立高等教育机构员工的绩效、参与度、动机、创造力和创新？
AI.motivation: 尽管奖励策略在吸引、保留和激励人才以维持竞争优势方面至关重要，但在南非背景下缺乏确凿的实证证据。组织需要了解哪些奖励成分能有效提升员工表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奖励系统理论（包括外在/内在奖励）、员工激励理论、组织行为学理论、人力资源管理理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究范式，描述性研究设计，同时收集横断面调查问卷和结构化一对一访谈数据，采用简单随机抽样，使用SPSS进行统计分析，定性数据采用解释性方法
AI.findings: 研究尚未完成，但预期将揭示不同奖励成分对员工创造力、创新、参与度、动机和绩效的具体影响，并开发适用的测量工具
AI.theory_contributions: 为奖励系统理论提供当代实证证据，丰富南非背景下的组织行为学研究，填补该领域实证研究的空白
AI.practical_contributions: 为人力资源管理、政策制定者和机构领导提供可操作的见解，设计公平、激励且与组织目标战略一致的奖励系统，解决员工流动率、满意度和绩效相关挑战

title: Strategic Growth and International Expansion of The Highway Company International (THCI): Opportunities and Challenges in Emerging Infrastructure Markets

detail.title: Strategic Growth and International Expansion of The Highway Company International (THCI): Opportunities and Challenges in Emerging Infrastructure Markets
detail.abstract: The companies that specialise in highway, road and transport corridor development have an opportunity set that is rapidly increasing in a global setting of fast-increasing infrastructure investment. In the case of a specialised company like The Highway Company International (THCI) (hereafter THCI), which deals with highway and transport infrastructure, the strategic growth necessity is the international growth, particularly into the emerging infrastructure markets. This report aims at discussing the growth rationale, opportunity landscape in the emerging markets, the strategic decisions that THCI will have to face and the fundamental issues it will encounter (Hönke et al., 2024). The bottom line is to determine how THICI can be placed to sustain its growth and what threats it needs to avoid.

AI.tldr: THCI作为高速公路和交通基础设施专业公司，面临全球基础设施投资快速增长的机会，需要通过进入新兴市场实现国际增长，但需要应对战略决策和挑战以维持可持续增长。
AI.research_question: THCI如何在新兴市场实现可持续的国际增长？需要避免哪些威胁？
AI.motivation: 全球基础设施投资快速增长为高速公路和交通基础设施专业公司创造了巨大机会，THCI需要抓住新兴市场的增长机遇来维持公司发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际增长战略、新兴市场进入策略、基础设施投资理论、战略决策框架
AI.method: 案例研究分析（基于THCI公司的具体情况），文献综述（引用Hönke等人2024年的研究）
AI.findings: THCI面临进入新兴市场的战略机遇，但需要应对复杂的战略决策和基本问题，以确保持续增长并避免潜在威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 为基础设施专业公司的国际增长战略提供了具体案例研究，丰富了新兴市场进入策略的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为THCI公司提供了进入新兴市场的战略指导，帮助识别增长机会和潜在威胁，为类似基础设施公司提供实践参考。

title: Supply Chain Resilience in Agro-Business: A Case Study of THCI Group Trade and Agricultural Technology Limited Company’s Trade Operations during Disruptions

detail.title: Supply Chain Resilience in Agro-Business: A Case Study of THCI Group Trade and Agricultural Technology Limited Company’s Trade Operations during Disruptions
detail.abstract: The influence of the supply chain disruption on agricultural business is highly sensitive since, in this aspect, they are subject to timely delivery, perishability, and supply chains network with a complex flow. THCI Group Trade and Agricultural Technology Limited Company (hereafter THCI Agro) is a business involved in trading in different agricultural markets; this company provides the trade and technologies as well as logistics services to be distributed to the farmers, distributors, and retailers. The global shocks that have happened recently, such as pandemics, climate change, and even geopolitical wars, provided the focus on the paramount nature of the supply chain resilience (Hansika et al., 2022). This report investigates a case study of how THCI Agro has been able to trade during interruptions, how to build resilient supply chain and lessons learnt that should be applied in future in the agro-business industries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过THCI Agro案例研究，探讨农业企业在供应链中断下的应对策略，分析如何构建弹性供应链，并为农业企业提供未来发展的经验教训。
AI.research_question: 农业企业THCI Agro如何在供应链中断期间维持贸易运营？如何构建弹性供应链？有哪些经验教训可应用于未来农业产业？
AI.motivation: 农业供应链对中断高度敏感，受及时交付、易腐性和复杂网络影响。近期全球冲击（疫情、气候变化、地缘战争）凸显了供应链弹性的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链弹性理论，供应链中断管理，农业供应链脆弱性分析，危机应对策略。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，以THCI Agro为研究对象，分析其在供应链中断期间的贸易实践和弹性建设策略。
AI.findings: THCI Agro通过特定策略在中断期间维持贸易，建立了弹性供应链机制，这些实践为农业企业提供了可借鉴的经验。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了农业供应链弹性理论，提供了具体企业层面的实证案例，扩展了供应链中断管理在农业领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业企业提供应对供应链中断的具体策略，指导构建弹性供应链，帮助农业产业提高抗风险能力。

title: Digital Transformation and Innovation in Infrastructure Investment Management: The Role of THCIIG LLC

detail.title: Digital Transformation and Innovation in Infrastructure Investment Management: The Role of THCIIG LLC
detail.abstract:
This paper explores a digital transformation process at THCIIG LLC by the leadership of Bashar Abdul Sattar and the impact of strategic leadership and technological innovation in how the infrastructure investment management can be transformed. The proposed study will investigate the role of a digital transformation, orchestrated by the leadership, in the enhancement of the efficiency of the operations, decision-making, and competitiveness in the conditions of the emerging market. The research questions will be four in number: What digital transformation initiatives were implemented at THCIIG? How has Bashar Abdul Sattar contributed to these changes and in which way? How were the results of these innovations? What can be learned by other similar firms?

In the study, a qualitative case study design is employed, that is, a combination of primary and secondary data, such as internal communication and leadership directives, industry reports, and scholarly sources. As the results indicate, with Sattar as the leader of THCIIG, the organization could guarantee the implementation of AI-based investment analytics, blockchain-based transparency, and smart digital asset management systems, which led to organizational flexibility and trustworthiness among investors. As it has been demonstrated in the paper, the drivers of value creation are stronger with the vision of leadership and technological adoption. The implications of this study both theoretically and practically underscore the primary importance of digital innovation by leaders in the development of the sustainable competitive advantage when it comes to the area of infrastructure investment.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了THCIIG公司在Bashar Abdul Sattar领导下进行的数字化转型过程，分析了战略领导力与技术创新的结合如何改变基础设施投资管理，并展示了数字化转型如何提升运营效率、决策质量和竞争力。
AI.research_question:
1. THCIIG实施了哪些数字化转型举措？
2. Bashar Abdul Sattar如何促成这些变革？
3. 这些创新举措取得了什么成果？
4. 其他类似公司可以从中学习到什么？
AI.motivation: 研究新兴市场条件下，基础设施投资管理如何通过数字化转型提升运营效率、决策质量和竞争力，探索战略领导力与技术创新的协同作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略领导力理论、数字化转型理论、技术创新理论、组织变革理论、竞争优势理论
AI.method: 定性案例研究设计，结合主要和次要数据，包括内部沟通文件、领导指示、行业报告和学术文献。
AI.findings: 在Sattar领导下，THCIIG成功实施了基于AI的投资分析、基于区块链的透明度系统和智能数字资产管理平台，显著提升了组织灵活性和投资者信任度，证明了领导力愿景与技术采纳是价值创造的关键驱动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上强调了领导力驱动的数字化转型在基础设施投资领域创造可持续竞争优势的重要性，丰富了战略领导力与技术创新整合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基础设施投资管理公司提供了数字化转型的具体实施路径和成功案例，展示了AI、区块链等技术在提升运营效率和投资者信任方面的实际应用价值。

title: AI Expectations and Market Stability

detail.title: AI Expectations and Market Stability
detail.abstract: I study the impact of adopting Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) as an expectation-formation technology on financial market stability. I extend a canonical experimental setup into a framework that: i) assesses whether AI Agents behave as rational agents, human-like learners, or adaptive stabilizers; ii) causally estimates how different AI models, or different ways of using the same model, influence price stability relative to fundamentals; and iii) structurally estimates a "hype susceptibility" parameter capturing a model's propensity to deviate from fundamental valuation. Applying the framework to a set of multimodal large language models (LLMs) from multiple providers, I find that GenAI Agents can act as market stabilizers, though not as fully rational agents, with substantial heterogeneity across architectures and use configurations. The framework is readily extendable to markets with heterogeneous AI participants, endogenous adoption of AI expectation technologies, and multimodal information shocks.

AI.tldr: 研究生成式人工智能作为预期形成技术对金融市场稳定性的影响，发现GenAI代理可以作为市场稳定器，但不是完全理性主体，不同架构和使用配置存在显著异质性。
AI.research_question: 采用生成式人工智能作为预期形成技术如何影响金融市场稳定性？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式人工智能在金融领域的应用日益广泛，需要理解AI作为预期形成技术对市场稳定性的影响，特别是不同AI模型和使用方式的效果差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典实验设置扩展的框架，评估AI代理作为理性主体、类人学习者或适应性稳定器的行为；包含"炒作敏感性"参数的结构估计。
AI.method: 扩展经典实验框架，对多模态大语言模型进行实验研究，包括因果估计不同AI模型或使用方式对价格稳定性的影响，以及结构估计"炒作敏感性"参数。
AI.findings: GenAI代理可以作为市场稳定器，但不是完全理性主体；不同架构和使用配置存在显著异质性；框架可扩展到异质AI参与者、AI技术内生采用和多模态信息冲击的市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估AI作为预期形成技术对市场稳定性影响的理论框架；引入了"炒作敏感性"参数概念；扩展了理性主体理论在AI环境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构选择和使用AI模型提供指导；为监管机构评估AI对市场稳定性的影响提供工具；帮助理解不同AI配置对市场行为的影响。

title: Microfoundations for Time-Varying Weights in Systemic Rate-of-Loss (SRDB) Inflation Theory
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Microfoundations for Time-Varying Weights in Systemic Rate-of-Loss (SRDB) Inflation Theory
detail.abstract: This article provides rigorous microfoundations for the time-varying weights in the Systemic Rate-of-Loss (SRDB) inflation framework. We derive the dynamics of three component weights from first-principles optimization: computational costs (w 1) via heterogeneous-agent overlapping-generations models with information frictions; financial risk (w 2) from firm pricing under cycle-dependent collateral constraints; and structural fragility (w 3) through conditional convergence in economic development. We prove that w 1 rises during Juglar credit booms by approximately 1.8 percentage points due to information saturation, w 2 peaks during Kondratiev downswings by 4.8 percentage points due to collateral tightening, and w 3 declines with development exhibiting 22-year convergence half-life. These derivations ground the SRDB framework in standard economic theory while explaining cycle-dependence and empirical regularities.

AI.tldr: 本文为系统性损失率(SRDB)通胀框架中的时变权重提供了严格的微观基础，从优化原理推导出三个权重分量的动态变化：计算成本权重(w1)、金融风险权重(w2)和结构脆弱性权重(w3)。
AI.research_question: 如何从微观经济原理推导SRDB通胀框架中三个权重分量(w1, w2, w3)的动态变化？
AI.motivation: 为SRDB通胀框架中的时变权重提供严格的微观基础，将经验观察与标准经济理论联系起来，解释权重随经济周期的变化规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 异质代理人世代交叠模型(信息摩擦)；2. 企业定价理论(周期依赖的抵押约束)；3. 条件收敛理论(经济发展)。
AI.method: 从优化原理推导：w1通过异质代理人世代交叠模型与信息摩擦；w2通过企业定价与周期依赖的抵押约束；w3通过条件收敛与经济发展。
AI.findings: 1. w1在朱格拉信贷繁荣期因信息饱和上升约1.8个百分点；2. w2在康德拉季耶夫下降期因抵押收紧达到峰值4.8个百分点；3. w3随发展而下降，收敛半衰期为22年。
AI.theory_contributions: 将SRDB框架建立在标准经济理论基础上，为时变权重提供微观基础，连接信息摩擦、金融约束和收敛理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了权重随经济周期的变化规律，为政策制定者理解不同经济周期阶段的通胀驱动因素提供理论依据。

title: Insurance Status, Regional Development, and Inequities in In-Hospital Stroke Care in China
affiliations: Yale University - School of Medicine, Capital Medical University - Department of Neurology, Capital Medical University - China National Clinical Research Center for Neurological Diseases and Capital Medical University - Department of Neurology

detail.title: Insurance Status, Regional Development, and Inequities in In-Hospital Stroke Care in China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study adherent to STROBE reporting guidelines. Ethics committees at Beijing Tiantan Hospital and all participating hospitals approved the protocol. Written informed consent was waived due to de-identified data.
declarations.funderStatement: National Key R&D Programme of China and National Institute of Hospital Administration

detail.abstract: SummaryBackgroundIschemic stroke accounts for a substantial share of premature mortality and long-term disability in China and worldwide. Despite widespread insurance coverage, substantial disparities in financial protection and service capacity remain across regions. How insurance status intersects with regional socioeconomic development to shape in-hospital management and outcomes has not been examined using national data.MethodsWe analyzed clinical data from adults hospitalized with ischemic stroke in the China Stroke Center Alliance from 2016 to 2019. Regional socioeconomic development was classified into four strata using the Human Development Index (HDI). Insurance categories included Urban Employee Basic Medical Insurance (UEBMI) and self-pay. Acute management indicators and in-hospital outcomes were compared across HDI–insurance groups using generalized estimating equations adjusting for demographics, comorbidities, pre-admission medications, stroke severity, and hospital level. Sensitivity analyses evaluated robustness across alternative model specifications.FindingsMarked structural differences in clinical profiles, care processes, and outcomes were observed across insurance groups and levels of regional development. Among 356 605 patients from 30 provinces, 292 840 (82·1%) were covered by UEBMI and 63 765 (17·9%) were self-pay. UEBMI beneficiaries were concentrated in higher-HDI regions and had a greater burden of documented comorbidities, whereas self-pay patients were younger (60 vs 68 years) and had lower prevalences of hypertension (58·6% vs 70·9%) and diabetes (14·5% vs 26·8%). Differences in acute management were most pronounced in lower-HDI regions, including lower use of vascular imaging among self-pay patients (85·2% vs 91·3%). Correspondingly, self-pay patients in low-HDI regions experienced substantially higher rates of discharge against medical advice (adjusted risk difference 8·5, 95% CI 6·7–10·3) and greater disability at discharge. These disparities attenuated but remained evident in higher-HDI settings. Sensitivity analyses yielded comparable estimates.InterpretationStroke care and outcomes in China showed clear socioeconomic gradients that mirrored differences in regional development and financial protection. Policy efforts to strengthen benefit design, expand service capacity in lower-HDI regions, and improve coordination across insurance schemes may advance equity in acute stroke care. These findings offer relevant insights for countries pursuing universal health coverage amid pronounced regional variation.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用中国卒中中心联盟2016-2019年数据，分析了缺血性卒中患者中保险状态与区域社会经济发展水平的交互作用对院内管理和结局的影响，发现显著的社会经济梯度差异。
AI.research_question: 保险状态如何与区域社会经济发展水平相互作用，影响缺血性卒中患者的院内管理和临床结局？
AI.motivation: 尽管中国已实现广泛的医疗保险覆盖，但不同地区在财务保护和服务能力方面仍存在显著差异。保险状态与区域发展如何共同影响卒中护理质量尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康公平理论和社会经济梯度概念，探讨保险覆盖与区域发展水平的交互作用对医疗服务质量的影响。
AI.method: 使用中国卒中中心联盟2016-2019年临床数据，纳入356,605名缺血性卒中患者。按人类发展指数(HDI)将地区分为四层，保险类型包括城镇职工基本医疗保险和自费。采用广义估计方程比较不同HDI-保险组的急性管理指标和院内结局，调整人口学、合并症、用药史、卒中严重程度和医院等级。
AI.findings:
1. UEBMI参保者集中在高HDI地区，合并症负担更重；自费患者更年轻，高血压和糖尿病患病率更低
2. 急性管理差异在低HDI地区最明显，自费患者血管成像使用率更低(85.2% vs 91.3%)
3. 低HDI地区自费患者自动出院率显著更高(调整后风险差8.5%)，出院时残疾程度更重
4. 这些差异在高HDI地区有所减弱但仍存在
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了保险状态与区域发展的交互作用对医疗服务质量的影响机制
2. 为健康公平理论提供了实证支持，展示了社会经济梯度在医疗系统中的具体表现
3. 深化了对全民健康覆盖背景下区域差异影响的理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了改善卒中护理公平性的具体方向：加强福利设计、扩大低HDI地区服务能力、改善保险方案协调
2. 为其他面临显著区域差异的国家推进全民健康覆盖提供了参考
3. 强调了在评估医疗质量时需要考虑保险状态与区域发展的交互作用

title: Hyperscale Data Centre Expansion in Australia: A White Paper for Institutional Investors

detail.title: Hyperscale Data Centre Expansion in Australia: A White Paper for Institutional Investors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relies exclusively on secondary information from public reports, market data and published sources. In accordance with institutional guidelines, formal ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract: This white paper presents a strategic investment framework for an institutional investor looking to deploy capital in Australia's Industrial & Logistics (I&L) sector, with a specific focus on the rapidly expanding data centre market. The analysis is designed for global real estate and infrastructure investors seeking recommendations grounded in macroeconomic conditions, sector fundamentals, and regional sub-market dynamics. It evaluates these factors and identifies Melbourne as the most suitable location for a large-scale, hyperscale-ready data centre investment. Once considered a niche, data centres have become a mainstream institutional asset class, underpinned by long-term structural demand from cloud adoption, AI workloads, and sovereign digital infrastructure. Their hybrid nature, combining infrastructure-grade power and cooling systems with real estate fundamentals such as long leases, stable income, and land appreciation, makes them central to the modern industrial asset class. This report adopts a real-asset investment lens, treating data centres as a specialised Industrial & Logistics (I&L) product while recognising their unique operational attributes. The macroeconomic analysis indicates Australia entering a more favourable phase in late 2025-2026. Inflation is expected to return to the Reserve Bank of Australia's 2-3% target band, and interest rates are projected to ease after several 25-bp cuts. The Australian dollar remains historically weak against the Japanese yen and the U.S. dollar, improving cross-border yields for international investors. Meanwhile, capital availability is increasing through domestic banks and private credit funds, easing financing constraints for large-scale developments. Sector-level analysis highlights a major shift from traditional hyperscale facilities to high-density, AI-ready data centres that require higher rack densities, grid stability, and advanced cooling technologies. Against this backdrop, Melbourne stands out as the most investable corridor after Sydney. It offers lower land and build costs, better medium-term power headroom, and strong demand from cloud, enterprise, and government users. Northern and western sub-markets such as Tullamarine, Mickleham, and West Footscray provide the most favourable conditions due to existing industrial zoning, strong transmission infrastructure, and proximity to fibre routes and major cloud regions. To support the recommendation, the report examines six international and Australian case studies: the Mitsui-CPPIB digital infrastructure JV in Japan, AirTrunk's hyperscale platform growth, Equinix's acquisition of Metronode, NEXTDC's organic expansion in Melbourne, the global merger of Digital Realty and Interxion, and the REIT strategies of Goodman Group and Digital Realty. These cases reveal consistent patterns that can guide the Fund's strategy, including the need to move early to secure power-ready land, 1 An earlier version of this white paper was prepared as coursework for 17772 Real Estate Economics (UTS, Spring 2025) and has been subsequently revised for wider dissemination.

AI.tldr: 本文为机构投资者提供了一个在澳大利亚工业与物流领域投资数据中心市场的战略框架，推荐墨尔本作为最适合大规模超大规模数据中心投资的地点。
AI.research_question: 对于寻求在澳大利亚工业与物流领域投资的机构投资者，特别是数据中心市场，哪个地区最适合进行大规模超大规模数据中心投资？
AI.motivation: 数据中心已从利基资产转变为主流机构资产类别，受云计算采用、AI工作负载和主权数字基础设施的长期结构性需求支撑。其混合特性（结合基础设施级电力冷却系统和房地产基本面）使其成为现代工业资产类别的核心。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用实物资产投资视角，将数据中心视为专业化的工业与物流产品，同时承认其独特的运营属性。分析框架包括宏观经济条件、行业基本面和区域子市场动态三个层面。
AI.method: 结合宏观经济分析、行业层面分析和区域子市场分析，并通过六个国际和澳大利亚案例研究（包括三井-CPPIB数字基础设施合资企业、AirTrunk超大规模平台增长、Equinix收购Metronode等）来支持推荐。
AI.findings: 墨尔本被确定为悉尼之后最具投资价值的走廊，提供更低的土地和建设成本、更好的中期电力余量以及来自云、企业和政府用户的强劲需求。Tullamarine、Mickleham和West Footscray等北部和西部子市场因现有工业分区、强大的输电基础设施以及靠近光纤路线和主要云区域而提供最有利条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据中心概念化为工业与物流资产类别内的专业化产品，同时承认其独特的基础设施特性，为房地产投资理论提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了具体的投资框架和地点推荐，包括墨尔本的具体子市场选择，以及从案例研究中提炼出的战略指导（如尽早获取电力就绪土地的重要性）。

title: Uniform-Price Auctions Are Fragile: How Balance Sheet Constraints Undermine Treasury Market Design
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Uniform-Price Auctions Are Fragile: How Balance Sheet Constraints Undermine Treasury Market Design
detail.abstract: Balance sheet constraints fundamentally undermine uniform-price Treasury auctions. I show theoretically that funding constraints increase price elasticity, rendering uniform pricing inefficient when constraints bind heterogeneously. Using U.S. Treasury data (20002025) and a triple-difference strategy, I find that a one-standard-deviation constraint tightening raises elasticity by 14.2 percentage points. I characterize the optimal mechanism, proving that discriminatory pricing dominates when constraint dispersion is high. These findings challenge the academic consensus and support statedependent format selection: uniform pricing for normal times, but discriminatory pricing during systemic stress.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究美国国债拍卖机制，发现资产负债表约束会破坏统一价格拍卖的效率。当约束异质性绑定时，资金约束会增加价格弹性，使统一定价变得低效。作者提出应根据市场条件选择拍卖机制：正常时期用统一价格，系统性压力时期用歧视性定价。
AI.research_question: 资产负债表约束如何影响美国国债拍卖机制效率？在什么条件下统一价格拍卖或歧视性定价更优？
AI.motivation: 现有学术共识认为统一价格拍卖优于歧视性定价，但实践中美国财政部仍使用歧视性定价。作者认为资产负债表约束这一关键因素被忽视，这可能是理论与现实差异的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于拍卖理论，分析资产负债表约束对竞标者行为的影响。约束增加价格弹性，当约束异质性绑定时，统一价格拍卖变得低效。
AI.method: 理论模型分析约束对拍卖效率的影响；实证使用美国国债数据（2000-2025年）和三重差分策略，量化约束收紧对价格弹性的影响。
AI.findings: 约束收紧一个标准差会使价格弹性增加14.2个百分点。当约束分散度高时，歧视性定价优于统一价格拍卖。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了统一价格拍卖总是更优的学术共识，提出状态依赖的拍卖机制选择理论：正常时期用统一价格，系统性压力时期用歧视性定价。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国财政部拍卖机制选择提供实证依据，建议根据市场压力程度灵活选择拍卖格式，提高拍卖效率和市场稳定性。

title: Teaching The Global South In The Global North: Scope, Methods, and Analytics in Political Sciences Education (Presentation Slides)

detail.title: Teaching The Global South In The Global North: Scope, Methods, and Analytics in Political Sciences Education (Presentation Slides)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjects were used in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: The author has no external funding or financial conflicts of interest to disclose.

detail.abstract:
Teaching the Global South in the Global North (TGSIGN) presents challenges and opportunities for educators committed to fostering deeper global awareness and global power relational parity. This approach to pedagogy aims to deconstruct dominant narratives that often marginalize Southern perspectives. Over the last decade, political science teacher-scholars have advocated for more inclusive curricula that recognize the complexities of global interdependence and disparities. With its historical and economic power dynamics, current Global North knowledge systems (ontologies, epistemologies, and scholarship) can unintentionally perpetuate stereotypes and oversimplifications of the Global South. Therefore, educators must critically engage with course materials, incorporating diverse voices, perspectives from Southern scholars and practitioners, themes, methods, data, and analytics.

Conducting a qualitative and quantitative systematic content analysis on N=4000+ research articles on political science education and pedagogy, and drawing upon transnational partnerships and participatory learning frameworks, this paper explores pedagogical strategies for integrating Global South (and internationalizing) content into curricula, emphasizing the importance of context, history, and lived experiences. It examines the trends and silences in the global discourse to identify gaps in content, methods, and analytics that, if filled, could enrich educational experiences for students studying political sciences (including political theory, international relations, foreign policy, public policy, public administration, government and governance, legal studies, and others).

The findings suggest that significant gaps exist in the political sciences canon and methodological theory and practice. The Northern curriculum tends to have a deep preference for mainstream Western-liberal-normative perspectives, while aspects of Western modern and classical political perspectives are largely unrepresented. Considering non-Western political knowledge, there is a greater representation of mainstream liberal-normative perspectives that prioritize a select group of theories, approaches, and methods that center on Global South perspectives. Perhaps, incorporating intersectional analysis that considers the role of special interest groups, diverse conservative and liberal perspectives, as well as other socio-political nuances, is crucial in understanding the multifaceted realities of the Global South and its connections to international issues. The role of technology in bridging educational divides also factored greatly in the findings, highlighting how digital platforms can be more deeply and seamlessly entrenched in pedagogy to facilitate knowledge exchange, methodological rigor, and collaborative learning. Teaching the Global South in the Global North, therefore, not only has the potential to enhance students’ global literacy but also to cultivate a deepened sense of global responsibility and collective stewardship.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过系统内容分析探讨了如何在北方政治学教育中整合南方内容，发现现有课程存在显著的知识和方法论空白，并提出通过技术平台和交叉分析来促进全球意识教育。
AI.research_question: 如何在北方政治学教育中有效整合南方内容和视角？现有课程存在哪些知识和方法论空白？
AI.motivation: 北方知识体系可能无意中延续对南方的刻板印象和简化，需要批判性教学法来解构主导叙事，促进全球权力关系平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨国伙伴关系框架、参与式学习框架、批判教育学、后殖民理论、全球权力关系理论。
AI.method: 对4000+篇政治学教育和教学法研究文章进行定性和定量系统内容分析。
AI.findings: 1. 政治学经典和方法论存在显著空白；2. 北方课程偏好西方自由主义规范视角；3. 非西方政治知识中主流自由主义视角占主导；4. 需要交叉分析考虑特殊利益群体等社会政治细微差别；5. 技术在弥合教育鸿沟中发挥重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别北方政治学教育中的系统性知识空白；2. 提出整合南方视角的理论框架；3. 强调交叉分析在理解南方复杂性中的重要性；4. 拓展全球教育理论的技术维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育者提供具体的教学策略；2. 强调技术平台在促进知识交流中的作用；3. 提供课程改革的具体方向；4. 促进全球素养和集体责任感的培养。

title: Licensing New Technologies in Oligopolistic Markets
affiliations: Stony Brook University, Beijing Jiaotong University and

detail.title: Licensing New Technologies in Oligopolistic Markets
detail.abstract: We study licensing in a unified model that encompasses both process and quality-improving innovations. In a Cournot industry with heterogeneous consumers, an innovator upgrades product quality from v L to v H and sells licenses via auction or fixed fee. The special case v H = v L and c H < c L corresponds to a standard process innovation. Licensing quality innovation overturns classic results: when returns to quality are decreasing and the industry is small, fixed fees outperform auctions, firms gain, and consumers may lose. Moreover, auctions may attract no buyers even when the innovator can profitably sell licenses at a fixed fee. In large industries, auctions dominate regardless of returns to quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了质量改进创新与工艺创新的许可策略，发现在小规模行业中，固定费用许可优于拍卖，可能损害消费者福利；而在大规模行业中，拍卖始终占优。
AI.research_question: 在包含质量改进创新和工艺创新的统一模型中，创新者应如何选择许可策略（拍卖 vs 固定费用）？这些策略如何影响行业结构、企业利润和消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注工艺创新的许可，但质量改进创新同样重要。需要建立一个统一框架来比较两种创新的许可策略差异，特别是当质量回报递减时，传统结论可能被颠覆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cournot竞争模型，考虑异质性消费者，产品从低质量v_L升级到高质量v_H。工艺创新作为特例（v_H=v_L且c_H<c_L）。分析许可策略：拍卖（auction）和固定费用（fixed fee）。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，在Cournot行业框架下，比较拍卖和固定费用两种许可机制。考虑行业规模（企业数量）和质量回报（递增/递减）的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 质量创新颠覆经典结论：在小规模行业且质量回报递减时，固定费用优于拍卖，企业获益，消费者可能受损。2. 拍卖可能无人竞标，即使固定费用许可有利可图。3. 在大规模行业中，无论质量回报如何，拍卖始终占优。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了统一框架同时分析工艺和质量改进创新的许可策略。2. 揭示了质量创新许可与传统工艺创新许可的根本差异。3. 识别了行业规模和质量回报在许可策略选择中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为创新者提供许可策略选择指导：小行业选固定费用，大行业选拍卖。2. 提醒政策制定者关注质量创新许可可能损害消费者福利。3. 帮助企业理解不同许可机制下的竞争动态。

title: The Bubble-Up Effect: National Policy Development on International Climate Refugees

detail.title: The Bubble-Up Effect: National Policy Development on International Climate Refugees

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjects were used in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: The author has no external funding or financial conflicts of interest to disclose.

detail.abstract: With the escalating impacts of climate change driving population displacement worldwide, the need for robust policy frameworks to address the plight of climate refugees has become increasingly urgent. In this study, I examine the development of national policy concerning international climate refugees. Climate refugee status is not currently established in international law. However, evolving discourse on refugee determination and admissions systems (RDS) suggests that although climate change is not currently a legally admissible threat on its own, in the future it could be considered when reviewing refugee applications. This might be particularly in circumstances where climate change has worsened violent conflicts or posed significant threats to human security. In the absence of a specific legally binding international framework and the growing number of people displaced across borders due to climate events, some states have begun establishing policies to address forced climate migration as part of their national immigration systems. The effects of which could resonate as global best practices when formal international law and policy on climate refugees develop in the future. This is what I refer to as the Bubble-Up Effect, where national-level policies influence international norms, instead of the usual trickle-down (top-down) norm diffusion. The literature on the subject of Climate Refugees is still nascent, despite recent expansion in the global discourse. Additional comprehensive analyses of the diverse policy approaches being adopted by different nations and the underlying factors shaping their responses are still needed. Furthermore, relatively greater attention is to be placed on the role of political economy, and even environmental/ecological factors, in shaping policy agendas, as well as the perspectives and experiences of affected communities in both national and international policy formulation processes. To address these gaps, this study takes a mixed-methods approach, which combines qualitative policy analysis with case studies and is framed within a political economy perspective. Content analysis is utilized to scrutinize legal proceedings, policy documents, and national policy frameworks that were developed to tackle the issue of international climate refugees. Meanwhile, case studies on the US, Canada, Australia, European Union, and Non-signatory countries (to the 1948 Refugee Convention) provide insights into the contextual factors that shape national policy responses, including political dynamics, institutional capacities, and socioeconomic considerations. This analysis identifies common features, divergences, and emerging best practices that may be useful as international norms on the issue develop. This study contributes to the discourse on the local-to-global evolution of refugee determination systems (RDS) and policy norms that could provide legal status and inform admission protocols for international climate refugees in the near or distant future.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨各国如何制定应对国际气候难民的国家政策，提出"自下而上效应"概念，即国家政策影响国际规范而非传统的自上而下扩散。研究采用混合方法分析美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、欧盟等案例，为未来国际气候难民法律地位和接纳协议提供参考。
AI.research_question: 各国如何制定应对国际气候难民的国家政策？这些政策如何影响未来国际气候难民法律地位和接纳协议的发展？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致的人口流离失所日益严重，但国际法尚未确立气候难民地位。在缺乏具有约束力的国际框架情况下，一些国家已开始制定应对政策。需要研究这些国家政策如何形成，以及它们如何影响未来国际规范的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学视角；"自下而上效应"（Bubble-Up Effect）概念，即国家层面政策影响国际规范，而非传统的自上而下规范扩散；难民认定与接纳系统（RDS）理论。
AI.method: 混合方法：结合定性政策分析、案例研究；内容分析法分析法律程序、政策文件和国家政策框架；案例研究包括美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、欧盟和1948年难民公约非签署国。
AI.findings: 识别各国气候难民政策的共同特征、差异和新兴最佳实践；分析政治动态、制度能力和社会经济因素如何塑造国家政策回应；探讨国家政策如何为未来国际规范发展提供参考。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"自下而上效应"概念，挑战传统的自上而下国际规范扩散理论；拓展难民认定系统（RDS）理论在气候难民领域的应用；为政治经济学视角下的环境移民政策研究提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国制定气候难民政策提供参考框架；识别可能成为国际最佳实践的政策模式；为未来国际气候难民法律地位和接纳协议的制定提供实证基础；强调受影响社区视角在政策制定中的重要性。

title: Search in Credence Goods Markets
affiliations: Stony Brook University and University of Tokyo

detail.title: Search in Credence Goods Markets
detail.abstract: We study consumer search in markets for horizontally differentiated expert services. A consumer faces a problem of unknown severity and consults experts for diagnosis and treatment. Because experts differ in match value, consumers search not only for honest recommendations but also for a better match. We show that an honest equilibrium can arise when search costs are sufficiently low, whereas in markets with homogeneous experts, any positive search cost eliminates honesty. Thus, horizontal differentiation provides a novel mechanism through which consumer search disciplines expert conduct. We also show that improving the search pool can unintentionally increase expert cheating.

AI.tldr: 研究消费者在水平差异化专家服务市场中的搜索行为，发现当搜索成本足够低时，诚实均衡可能出现，而专家同质化市场中任何正搜索成本都会消除诚实。水平差异化为消费者搜索约束专家行为提供了新机制，但改善搜索池可能意外增加专家欺诈。
AI.research_question: 在水平差异化的专家服务市场中，消费者搜索如何影响专家的诚实行为？
AI.motivation: 消费者在面对未知严重程度的问题时需要咨询专家进行诊断和治疗，但专家之间存在匹配价值差异，消费者不仅搜索诚实的建议，也搜索更好的匹配。需要理解这种双重搜索如何影响市场均衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水平差异化理论、消费者搜索理论、专家服务市场理论、信息不对称下的委托代理框架
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建消费者搜索和专家行为的经济模型，分析不同市场条件下的均衡
AI.findings: 1. 当搜索成本足够低时，诚实均衡可能出现；2. 在专家同质化市场中，任何正搜索成本都会消除诚实；3. 水平差异化为消费者搜索约束专家行为提供了新机制；4. 改善搜索池可能意外增加专家欺诈
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将水平差异化引入专家服务市场的搜索分析；2. 揭示了消费者搜索约束专家行为的新机制；3. 解释了为何在某些市场条件下诚实均衡能够存在；4. 提出了搜索池改善可能产生意外后果的理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构设计专家服务市场政策提供理论依据；2. 帮助消费者理解搜索策略的重要性；3. 为平台设计搜索机制提供参考；4. 提醒政策制定者注意改善搜索池可能带来的意外负面效应

title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists as Novel Pharmacotherapy for Substance Use and Behavioral Addictions: Clinical Evidence, Mechanisms, and Public Health Implications

detail.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists as Novel Pharmacotherapy for Substance Use and Behavioral Addictions: Clinical Evidence, Mechanisms, and Public Health Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Background: Substance use disorders (SUDs) and behavioral addictions represent a global public health crisis, affecting millions and contributing to significant mortality, morbidity, and economic burden. Current pharmacotherapies are limited in number, efficacy, and adoption. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs), approved for type 2 diabetes and obesity, have emerged as promising novel treatments for addictive disorders based on accumulating preclinical and clinical evidence. Objective: This comprehensive white paper synthesizes the latest clinical evidence (2023-2025) on GLP-1RAs for addiction treatment, examines underlying neurobiological mechanisms, evaluates comparative effectiveness across substance types, and discusses policy, economic, and implementation implications. Methods: Systematic review of peer-reviewed literature, including randomized controlled trials (RCTs), real-world observational studies, registry analyses, and preclinical research published through December 2025. Primary focus on semaglutide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, and exenatide.

AI.tldr: 这篇白皮书综述了2023-2025年关于GLP-1受体激动剂治疗成瘾障碍的最新临床证据，分析了其神经生物学机制，评估了不同物质类型的疗效，并讨论了政策、经济和实施意义。
AI.research_question: GLP-1受体激动剂作为成瘾障碍新型治疗方法的临床效果、神经机制、跨物质类型疗效比较以及政策实施可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 物质使用障碍和行为成瘾是全球公共卫生危机，现有药物治疗数量有限、效果不足且采用率低，而GLP-1受体激动剂在糖尿病和肥胖治疗中的成功应用为其在成瘾治疗中的潜力提供了基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于GLP-1受体激动剂在调节奖赏通路、减少渴求和预防复发方面的神经生物学机制，以及其在代谢调节和食欲控制方面的已知作用。
AI.method: 对截至2025年12月发表的同行评议文献进行系统综述，包括随机对照试验、真实世界观察性研究、注册分析和临床前研究，重点关注司美格鲁肽、利拉鲁肽、度拉糖肽和艾塞那肽。
AI.findings: GLP-1受体激动剂在治疗多种成瘾障碍中显示出潜力，通过调节中脑边缘多巴胺系统减少奖赏寻求行为，在不同物质类型中表现出不同程度的疗效，且具有较好的安全性和耐受性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了GLP-1信号通路在成瘾神经生物学中的作用理论，为成瘾治疗提供了新的药理学靶点，建立了代谢调节与奖赏系统之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床医生提供了基于证据的治疗选择，为政策制定者提供了实施指南，为药物研发提供了新方向，并可能降低成瘾相关的医疗成本和社会负担。

title: Many Men, Many Minds: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach to Disagreement and Global Asset Pricing
affiliations: , Shandong University of Finance and Economics and PBCSF, Tsinghua University

detail.title: Many Men, Many Minds: A Multi-Agent LLM Approach to Disagreement and Global Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: We develop a novel multi-agent framework based on large language models (LLMs) to quantify investor disagreement in cryptocurrency markets. By deploying three distinct Gemini-1.5-Flash agents to process financial news, we decompose disagreement into within-group belief dispersion and cross-group stance polarization. We uncover a sharp contrast in how these two components are priced: within-group uncertainty fuels speculative trading and exerts downward price pressure, consistent with heightened risk aversion (an uncertainty premium), whereas cross-group polarization reduces liquidity and predicts higher subsequent returns, consistent with short-sale constraints and canonical disagreement-based pricing mechanism. Extending the analysis to 32 global equity markets, we show that cryptocurrency-based disagreement is a powerful leading indicator of international equity returns, with predictive power orthogonal to standard global macro-financial factors. Notably, we document geographic heterogeneity in transmission: developed markets are more sensitive to bearish disagreement, whereas emerging markets respond more strongly to bullish disagreement. Recursive out-of-sample forecasting and economic value tests further indicate economically meaningful annualized certainty-equivalent return gains, especially in developed markets, highlighting cryptocurrency disagreement as a novel state variable for global asset pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架来量化加密货币市场的投资者分歧，将分歧分解为组内信念分散和组间立场极化，发现两者对价格的影响机制不同，且加密货币分歧能预测全球32个股票市场的回报。
AI.research_question: 投资者分歧如何影响加密货币市场价格？加密货币市场的分歧能否预测全球股票市场的回报？
AI.motivation: 传统投资者分歧度量方法在加密货币市场存在局限性，需要更精细的框架来分解分歧的不同维度及其对资产定价的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者分歧理论、不确定性溢价理论、卖空约束理论、资产定价理论
AI.method: 基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，使用三个Gemini-1.5-Flash智能体处理金融新闻，将分歧分解为组内信念分散和组间立场极化，并扩展到32个全球股票市场进行预测分析。
AI.findings: 1. 组内不确定性促进投机交易并对价格产生下行压力（不确定性溢价）；2. 组间极化降低流动性并预测更高后续回报（卖空约束）；3. 加密货币分歧是全球股票回报的领先指标，预测能力独立于标准宏观金融因素；4. 发达市场对看跌分歧更敏感，新兴市场对看涨分歧更敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出基于LLM的多智能体框架量化投资者分歧；2. 将分歧分解为组内分散和组间极化两个维度；3. 揭示两种分歧成分的不同定价机制；4. 将加密货币分歧确立为全球资产定价的新状态变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供新的市场情绪监测工具；2. 加密货币分歧可作为全球股票市场的预测指标；3. 为不同市场类型（发达vs新兴）提供差异化的投资策略建议；4. 递归样本外预测显示显著的经济价值增益。

Originally developed for type 2 diabetes and obesity, these medications demonstrate unique potential for addressing both the behavioral and metabolic components of eating disorders through simultaneous modulation of homeostatic satiety pathways and hedonic reward circuits.

AI.tldr: GLP-1R激动剂作为新兴治疗药物，对暴食症和神经性贪食症具有独特潜力，能同时调节稳态饱腹通路和享乐奖励回路，解决饮食障碍的行为和代谢双重问题。
AI.research_question: GLP-1R激动剂如何有效治疗暴食症和神经性贪食症，其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 饮食障碍（特别是暴食症和神经性贪食症）缺乏有效药物治疗，GLP-1R激动剂在糖尿病和肥胖治疗中显示出潜力，可能为饮食障碍提供新的治疗选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于稳态饱腹通路和享乐奖励回路的双重调节理论，GLP-1R激动剂通过同时影响生理饱腹感和心理奖励机制来治疗饮食障碍。
AI.method: 文献综述和机制分析，探讨GLP-1R激动剂在饮食障碍治疗中的药理作用和临床潜力。
AI.findings: GLP-1R激动剂能同时调节稳态饱腹通路和享乐奖励回路，对暴食症和神经性贪食症具有独特治疗潜力，可同时解决行为和代谢问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了GLP-1R激动剂通过双重机制（稳态+享乐）治疗饮食障碍的理论框架，为理解药物作用机制提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为暴食症和神经性贪食症提供了新的药物治疗选择，具有临床应用潜力，可能改善现有治疗效果。

title: New-Keynesian Inflation Control is Equilibrium Selection
affiliations: Hoover Institution

detail.title: New-Keynesian Inflation Control is Equilibrium Selection
detail.abstract: The standard New-Keynesian model is often misinterpreted to embody old-Keynesian intuition: Higher nominal interest rates raise real interest rates, which lower output and employment, and via the Phillips curve lower inflation. That's not how the equations work. The entire ability of the standard model to lower inflation with higher nominal interest rates comes from a coincident equilibrium-selection/fiscal shock, independent of the interest rate movement. With short-term debt, any lowering of inflation requires a fiscal tightening. Long-term debt and sufficiently persistent shocks can produce lower inflation with no change in fiscal policy. The central role of equilibrium selection is hidden by Taylor rules with AR(1) disturbances. Non-AR(1) Taylor rule disturbances produce the same path of interest rates, but different inflation. The choice of disturbance process is thus an independent equilibrium-selection choice. It is more revealing to characterize the model's dynamics by the path of interest rates and the initial equilibrium-selection shock, which are observable, unlike Taylor rule disturbances.

AI.tldr: 标准新凯恩斯模型常被误解为体现旧凯恩斯直觉：提高名义利率会提高实际利率，从而降低产出和就业，并通过菲利普斯曲线降低通胀。但模型的实际机制并非如此。标准模型通过提高名义利率来降低通胀的能力完全来自一个伴随的均衡选择/财政冲击，与利率变动无关。短期债务下，任何通胀下降都需要财政紧缩。长期债务和足够持久的冲击可以在不改变财政政策的情况下降低通胀。均衡选择的核心作用被带有AR(1)扰动的泰勒规则所掩盖。非AR(1)泰勒规则扰动会产生相同的利率路径但不同的通胀路径。因此扰动过程的选择是一个独立的均衡选择决策。更清晰的表征方式是通过利率路径和初始均衡选择冲击来描述模型动态，这些是可观测的，而泰勒规则扰动则不可观测。
AI.research_question: 标准新凯恩斯模型中，提高名义利率降低通胀的实际机制是什么？均衡选择在通胀动态中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 标准新凯恩斯模型常被误解为体现旧凯恩斯直觉：提高名义利率会提高实际利率，从而降低产出和就业，并通过菲利普斯曲线降低通胀。作者指出这种理解是错误的，需要澄清模型的实际运作机制，特别是均衡选择和财政冲击的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义宏观经济学、均衡选择理论、财政理论、泰勒规则、菲利普斯曲线、名义利率与实际利率关系、债务期限结构理论。
AI.method: 理论分析、数学模型推导、比较静态分析、均衡选择机制分析、不同债务期限结构下的动态分析。
AI.findings: 1. 标准新凯恩斯模型降低通胀的能力来自伴随的均衡选择/财政冲击，而非利率变动本身。2. 短期债务下，通胀下降需要财政紧缩。3. 长期债务和持久冲击可以在不改变财政政策的情况下降低通胀。4. 泰勒规则中的AR(1)扰动掩盖了均衡选择的核心作用。5. 非AR(1)扰动会产生相同的利率路径但不同的通胀路径。6. 扰动过程的选择是独立的均衡选择决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清了新凯恩斯模型中利率政策影响通胀的实际机制。2. 强调了均衡选择在通胀动态中的核心作用。3. 揭示了泰勒规则扰动过程选择的均衡选择本质。4. 提出了基于可观测变量（利率路径和初始均衡选择冲击）的模型动态表征方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行制定货币政策提供了更准确的理论指导。2. 强调了财政政策在通胀控制中的重要性。3. 指出了债务期限结构对货币政策效果的影响。4. 提供了评估货币政策效果的新框架。

title: Does Authority Framing Increase Susceptibility to Misinformation? An Experimental Analysis of Truthfulness, Sharing, Vigilance, and Confidence

detail.title: Does Authority Framing Increase Susceptibility to Misinformation? An Experimental Analysis of Truthfulness, Sharing, Vigilance, and Confidence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved human participants and was conducted in accordance with the ethical guidelines of Erasmus University Rotterdam. Informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to participation, and all data were collected anonymously.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The accelerating dissemination of misinformation in the digital era poses a serious societal challenge. This thesis explores how subtle cues of authority influence people's susceptibility to misinformation. A 2x2 between-subjects design online experiment was conducted (n=173), where participants were randomly assigned to view short videos presenting true or false news-style statements framed either as authoritative (university podium) or neutral (no cues). After viewing the videos as part of the survey, participants rated their perceived truthfulness, willingness to share, epistemic vigilance, and confidence in judgment (on 5-point Likert scales). The results indicated that authoritative framing significantly increases willingness to share misinformation and reduces participants' epistemic vigilance. Interestingly, no effects were found on perceived truthfulness and confidence in their judgment. Furthermore, media literacy and familiarity with academia moderate these effects, acting as protective factors against misinformation. Practical implications for media literacy education and information platform design are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验发现权威性框架会显著增加人们分享错误信息的意愿并降低认知警惕性，但不会影响对信息真实性的感知。媒体素养和学术熟悉度能调节这些效应，起到保护作用。
AI.research_question: 权威性线索如何影响人们对错误信息的易感性？
AI.motivation: 数字时代错误信息加速传播构成严重社会挑战，需要理解权威性线索如何影响人们对错误信息的反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于权威性说服理论、认知警惕性理论和媒体素养理论，探讨权威性框架如何影响信息处理过程。
AI.method: 2x2被试间设计在线实验（n=173），参与者随机观看呈现真实或虚假新闻式陈述的视频，框架分为权威性（大学讲台）或中性（无线索）。测量感知真实性、分享意愿、认知警惕性和判断信心（5点李克特量表）。
AI.findings: 权威性框架显著增加分享错误信息的意愿并降低认知警惕性，但对感知真实性和判断信心无影响。媒体素养和学术熟悉度调节这些效应，起到保护作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了权威性说服理论在错误信息传播中的应用，揭示了权威性框架对行为意图（分享）和认知警惕性的独特影响模式，而非对真实性判断的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体素养教育提供实证依据，强调培养对权威性线索的批判性思维；为信息平台设计提供建议，如减少不必要的权威性视觉线索或添加警示标签。

title: Fintech and Financial Inclusion in Emerging Economies: Evidence From Digital Payments, Mobile Banking, and Entrepreneurial Finance

detail.title: Fintech and Financial Inclusion in Emerging Economies: Evidence From Digital Payments, Mobile Banking, and Entrepreneurial Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare that they have no known personal or financial relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals. All data used were obtained from publicly available sources, and no identifiable personal data were collected.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Financial inclusion remains a persistent challenge in emerging economies, where large segments of the population lack access to formal financial services. The rapid diffusion of financial technology (FinTech) has been widely promoted as a transformative solution capable of bridging institutional gaps, reducing transaction costs, and expanding access to financial services. This study investigates the impact of FinTech adoption on financial inclusion in emerging economies, with particular emphasis on digital payments, mobile banking, and FinTech-enabled entrepreneurial finance. Using panel data from selected emerging economies between 2015 and 2024, the study employs fixed-effects regression and instrumental variable techniques to examine the relationship between FinTech penetration and financial inclusion indicators. The findings indicate that FinTech adoption significantly improves access to financial services, increases usage of formal financial products, and enhances financial participation among micro-entrepreneurs and underserved populations. However, the results also reveal persistent digital divides related to income, education, and infrastructure quality. The study contributes to the literature by providing empirical evidence on the inclusionary potential of FinTech while highlighting policy trade-offs relevant for regulators and development institutions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了金融科技（FinTech）在促进新兴经济体金融包容性方面的作用，发现FinTech能显著提升金融服务获取和使用，但也揭示了数字鸿沟问题。
AI.research_question: 金融科技采纳对新兴经济体金融包容性有何影响？特别是数字支付、移动银行和FinTech支持的创业金融如何影响金融包容性？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体中大量人口缺乏正规金融服务，金融包容性持续面临挑战。金融科技被广泛认为是能够弥补制度差距、降低交易成本并扩大金融服务获取的变革性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、数字金融理论、制度理论（弥补制度差距）、交易成本理论
AI.method: 使用2015-2024年选定新兴经济体的面板数据，采用固定效应回归和工具变量技术，分析FinTech渗透率与金融包容性指标之间的关系。
AI.findings: FinTech采纳显著改善了金融服务获取，增加了正规金融产品的使用，并提升了微型企业家和服务不足人群的金融参与度。但结果也揭示了与收入、教育和基础设施质量相关的持续数字鸿沟。
AI.theory_contributions: 为FinTech的包容性潜力提供了实证证据，丰富了金融包容性和数字金融理论，同时强调了制度差距弥补和交易成本降低的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和发展机构提供了政策权衡的相关见解，指出了需要解决数字鸿沟问题，以充分发挥FinTech在促进金融包容性方面的潜力。

title: Conspicuous Inequality: Speculative Housing Booms and Property Crime in China
affiliations: Tsinghua University - School of Economics & Management, ,  and INSE at Peking University

detail.title: Conspicuous Inequality: Speculative Housing Booms and Property Crime in China
detail.abstract: This paper identifies the causal effect of housing speculation on crime by exploiting spillovers from house purchase restrictions (HPR) in major Chinese cities. These policies redirected speculative demand to nearby unregulated markets, triggering sharp and exogenous housing booms. Using newly constructed measures of criminal activity derived from large-scale text analysis of court judgments, we show that speculative housing booms increase property crime but not violent crime. The rise is concentrated in financially motivated offenses—larceny, fraud, and high-value robbery—and is committed primarily by socioeconomically vulnerable individuals and first-time offenders. Mechanism analyses reveal that housing booms widen wealth inequality and make affluence more visible through conspicuous consumption, raising both the expected returns to crime and the ease of targeting. Alternative explanations such as deprivation, social strain, migration, or weakened deterrence find no support. The results highlight a new social cost of housing speculation: by amplifying visible inequality, it erodes cohesion and fuels crime.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国主要城市的住房限购政策作为自然实验，发现住房投机通过财富不平等加剧和炫耀性消费增加，显著提升了财产犯罪率，但对暴力犯罪无影响。
AI.research_question: 住房投机如何影响犯罪率？具体机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 住房投机在全球范围内普遍存在，但其社会成本研究不足。中国城市住房限购政策为研究住房投机与犯罪关系提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于犯罪经济学理论，特别是预期收益与目标易得性框架；同时考虑财富不平等和炫耀性消费对犯罪决策的影响。
AI.method: 利用中国主要城市住房限购政策作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法；通过大规模文本分析法院判决构建犯罪活动新指标；进行机制分析和替代解释检验。
AI.findings: 住房投机繁荣显著增加财产犯罪（盗窃、诈骗、高价值抢劫），但对暴力犯罪无影响；犯罪者主要为社会经济弱势群体和初犯；机制是财富不平等加剧和炫耀性消费使富裕更显眼。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证识别住房投机对犯罪的因果效应；提出"可见不平等"作为犯罪驱动机制；拓展了犯罪经济学在房地产市场中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示住房投机的社会成本；为城市住房政策设计提供犯罪预防视角；建议关注财富不平等和炫耀性消费对社区安全的影响。

title: Energy Shortage and Stock Return Predictability
affiliations: and Hunan University - School of Finance and Statistics

detail.title: Energy Shortage and Stock Return Predictability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the time-series predictability of the energy shortage index (ESI) for equity risk premiums. Our empirical results show that ESI is significantly and negatively associated with future stock returns, both in-sample and out-of-sample, and consistently outperforms a comprehensive set of traditional competing predictors. We further document that the predictive power of the ESI strengthens as the forecast horizon extends and remains robust across both economic expansions and recessions. Importantly, this predictability is not limited to the U.S. market but extends to major international equity markets. Portfolio analysis confirms that integrating ESI into mean-variance frameworks generates economically meaningful utility gains for investors. Mechanism analyses suggest that the predictive efficacy of the ESI stem from both the cash-flow and discount-rate channels, as well as its significant links to investor behavior and macroeconomic fundamentals. Finally, the predictive power of ESI is robust across cross-sections and alternative evaluation specifications.

AI.tldr: 能源短缺指数（ESI）能显著预测股票风险溢价，预测能力随预测期限延长而增强，且在全球市场均有效，通过现金流和折现率渠道以及投资者行为机制发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 能源短缺指数（ESI）是否能够预测股票风险溢价？其预测能力在不同市场、不同经济周期和不同预测期限下表现如何？
AI.motivation: 传统股票预测因子存在局限性，能源短缺作为重要的宏观经济变量，可能通过影响企业现金流、折现率和投资者行为等渠道影响股票回报，但缺乏系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论，能源短缺可能通过现金流渠道（影响企业盈利能力）和折现率渠道（影响风险溢价）影响股票回报；同时结合行为金融学，能源短缺可能影响投资者情绪和风险偏好。
AI.method: 采用时间序列回归分析，包括样本内和样本外预测检验；进行投资组合分析，评估ESI在均值-方差框架中的效用增益；进行机制分析，检验现金流、折现率、投资者行为和宏观经济基础等渠道。
AI.findings: ESI与未来股票回报显著负相关，预测能力优于传统预测因子；预测能力随预测期限延长而增强，在经济扩张和衰退期均稳健；预测能力不仅限于美国市场，也适用于主要国际市场；纳入ESI能带来显著的投资效用增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究能源短缺对股票回报的预测能力；扩展了资产定价理论中能源因素的作用；为理解能源市场与股票市场联动提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了新的有效预测工具；展示了ESI在投资组合构建中的实际应用价值；为风险管理提供了能源风险视角。

title: Forecasting Global Stock Market Volatility in an Uncertain World
affiliations: Hunan University - School of Finance and Statistics,  and Hunan University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Forecasting Global Stock Market Volatility in an Uncertain World

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper constructs a novel aggregated uncertainty indicator based on machine learning to forecast monthly stock market volatility of international equity markets. We find that, compared with existing uncertainty indices, the aggregated uncertainty indicator demonstrates superior in-sample and out-of-sample forecasting performance across a broad cross-section of international stock markets. Specifically, it exhibits particularly strong short-term predictive power in developed markets, while displaying more pronounced long-term forecasting ability in emerging markets. Moreover, the economic value analysis demonstrates that incorporating the aggregated uncertainty index into investment strategies significantly enhances economic utility of investors relative to benchmark models. We further identify that uncertainty affects stock market volatility primarily through the channels of investor behavior and macroeconomic fundamentals. Finally, a series of robustness checks confirm the stability and reliability of our findings. Overall, this study provides new insights for global investors and regulators in understanding and managing market risk under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于机器学习的新型聚合不确定性指标，用于预测国际股票市场的月度波动率。研究发现该指标在样本内和样本外预测性能均优于现有不确定性指数，在发达市场具有更强的短期预测能力，在新兴市场则表现出更显著的长期预测能力。经济价值分析显示该指标能显著提升投资策略的经济效用。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个有效的聚合不确定性指标来预测国际股票市场的波动率？该指标在不同类型市场（发达vs新兴）中的预测能力有何差异？不确定性通过哪些渠道影响股票市场波动？
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性指标在预测国际股票市场波动率方面存在局限性，需要开发更有效的预测工具来帮助全球投资者和监管机构在不确定性环境下理解和管控市场风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性对股票市场波动影响的理论，结合投资者行为理论和宏观经济基础理论，构建不确定性通过投资者行为和宏观经济基本面渠道影响市场波动的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用机器学习方法构建聚合不确定性指标，进行样本内和样本外预测性能检验，使用经济价值分析评估投资策略效用，通过渠道分析识别不确定性影响机制，并进行系列稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1）聚合不确定性指标在预测国际股票市场波动率方面优于现有指数；2）在发达市场具有更强的短期预测能力，在新兴市场具有更显著的长期预测能力；3）纳入该指标能显著提升投资策略的经济效用；4）不确定性主要通过投资者行为和宏观经济基本面渠道影响市场波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了基于机器学习的新型聚合不确定性指标；2）揭示了不确定性在不同类型市场中预测能力的异质性；3）识别了不确定性影响股票市场波动的具体渠道机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为全球投资者提供了有效的市场风险预测工具；2）为监管机构提供了市场风险管理的新视角；3）为投资策略优化提供了实证依据。

title: Institutional Non-Response: An Unmeasured Patient Safety Risk in Modern Health Systems

detail.title: Institutional Non-Response: An Unmeasured Patient Safety Risk in Modern Health Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Patient safety frameworks have historically emphasized the identification and analysis of discrete adverse events, clinical errors, and sentinel outcomes after harm has occurred. Although these approaches have improved transparency and accountability, they are poorly suited to detecting safety risks that develop through prolonged periods of institutional inaction. As health care delivery becomes increasingly digitized, asynchronous, and distributed across teams, patient harm is less likely to arise from single catastrophic failures than from unresolved delays embedded in routine system operations.

This Viewpoint introduces institutional non-response, the failure of a health care system to act on known clinical or safety-relevant information within timeframes necessary to preserve patient safety, as an underrecognized and unmeasured patient safety risk. Distinct from diagnostic uncertainty or clinical error, institutional non-response reflects system latency after information has already been identified, documented, and acknowledged. Drawing on safety science, systems theory, and health information technology literature, this article argues that delayed follow-up, stalled escalation pathways, and procedural acknowledgment without clinical resolution constitute measurable pre-harm safety hazards that frequently evade existing oversight mechanisms. Recognizing institutional non-response as a safety signal may enable earlier detection of unsafe trajectories using data that health systems already collect and strengthen alignment between patient safety measurement, governance, and patient protection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"制度性无响应"概念，指医疗系统在已知临床或安全相关信息后，未在保护患者安全所需时间内采取行动，这是一种未被充分认识的患者安全风险。
AI.research_question: 制度性无响应如何构成患者安全风险，以及如何通过现有数据更早地检测这种风险？
AI.motivation: 传统患者安全框架侧重于分析已发生的离散不良事件和临床错误，但难以检测通过长期制度不作为形成的安全风险。随着医疗数字化、异步化和团队分散化，患者伤害更可能源于常规系统操作中未解决的延迟，而非单一灾难性故障。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全科学、系统理论和健康信息技术文献，强调系统延迟在信息已被识别、记录和确认后的影响。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于现有文献和理论构建"制度性无响应"概念，并论证其作为可测量的预伤害安全危害的特征。
AI.findings: 延迟随访、停滞的升级路径、程序性确认但无临床解决方案构成了可测量的预伤害安全危害，这些危害经常逃避现有监督机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制度性无响应"这一新概念，区别于诊断不确定性或临床错误，强调系统在信息确认后的延迟响应作为安全风险的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 将制度性无响应识别为安全信号，可能使医疗系统能够利用已收集的数据更早检测不安全轨迹，并加强患者安全测量、治理和患者保护之间的协调。

title: ESG Investing and Corporate Performance in Emerging Markets

detail.title: ESG Investing and Corporate Performance in Emerging Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare that they have no known personal or financial relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals. All data used were obtained from publicly available sources, and no identifiable personal data were collected.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investing has emerged as a key driver of sustainable corporate practices and long-term financial performance. While ESG adoption is extensively studied in developed markets, evidence from emerging economies remains limited and inconclusive due to unique institutional, regulatory, and market conditions. This study investigates the relationship between ESG performance and corporate financial outcomes measured by return on assets (ROA), return on equity (ROE), and Tobin's Q in 500 publicly listed firms across 15 emerging markets over the period 2015-2024. Using panel data regression models, complemented by robustness checks and instrumental variable estimation to address endogeneity, the study examines the differential effects of environmental, social, and governance components on firm performance and explores the moderating role of institutional quality. The results indicate that higher ESG performance is positively associated with corporate financial outcomes, with governance practices exhibiting the strongest influence. Institutional quality further strengthens the ESG-performance link, highlighting the importance of supportive regulatory and governance environments. The study contributes to the literature by extending empirical evidence of ESGfinancial performance linkages to emerging markets and offers actionable insights for policymakers, investors, and corporate managers seeking to leverage ESG practices for competitive advantage and sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了新兴市场中ESG绩效与企业财务绩效（ROA、ROE、Tobin's Q）的关系，发现ESG表现越好，财务绩效越佳，其中治理因素影响最强，制度质量起正向调节作用。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场中ESG绩效与企业财务绩效（ROA、ROE、Tobin's Q）之间存在何种关系？环境、社会和治理三个维度的相对影响如何？制度质量是否调节这种关系？
AI.motivation: 虽然ESG投资在发达市场已被广泛研究，但新兴经济体的证据有限且不一致，因为其独特的制度、监管和市场条件可能影响ESG与财务绩效的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利益相关者理论、资源基础观和制度理论，探讨ESG实践如何通过风险管理、声誉提升和资源获取等机制影响企业财务绩效。
AI.method: 使用2015-2024年15个新兴市场500家上市公司的面板数据，采用面板回归模型，辅以稳健性检验和工具变量估计解决内生性问题，并检验制度质量的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. ESG绩效与企业财务绩效正相关；2. 治理实践的影响最强；3. 制度质量正向调节ESG与绩效的关系，支持性监管和治理环境能增强ESG的积极效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESG-财务绩效关系的实证证据扩展到新兴市场，丰富了制度理论在ESG研究中的应用，揭示了不同ESG维度的差异化影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供加强制度建设的依据，为投资者提供新兴市场ESG投资决策参考，为企业管理者提供优化ESG实践以获取竞争优势的指导。

title: Behind the Façade of the National Executive Councils of Political Parties in Africa: What the Governments Ought to Do or Not to Do?
affiliations: Durban University of Technology and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Behind the Façade of the National Executive Councils of Political Parties in Africa: What the Governments Ought to Do or Not to Do?
detail.abstract: This paper explores the intricate dynamics behind the façade of National Executive Councils (NECs) within political parties in Africa, scrutinizing their role in shaping governance and democratic practices. Despite often being perceived as bastions of democracy, many NECs function under opaque mechanisms that can perpetuate authoritarianism and hinder genuine political participation. This study examines the structural and operational challenges faced by NECs, including issues of internal dissent, lack of transparency, and the influence of external actors. This systematic qualitative method aimed to explore the Behind the façade of the National Executive Councils of Political Parties in Africa. The methodology involved a structured approach gathering and analysing qualitative data from relevant online literature sources, and expert opinions. Selection of articles focused on peer-reviewed 51 articles from 1971 to 2015 that discussed Behind the façade of the National Executive Councils of Political Parties in Africa. Data was categorised as the Behind the façade of the National Executive Councils of Political Parties in Africa. This systematic approach aimed to provide insights into Behind the façade of the National Executive Councils of Political Parties in Africa. The findings emphasize the need for governments to reform political party structures through promoting internal democracy, enhancing transparency, and fostering inclusive participation. It argues against excessive government intervention, advocating for a regulatory framework that supports self-regulation and accountability. The study highlights the importance of reforming National Electoral Commissions (NECs) to strengthen democracy in Africa and calls for collaboration among governments, civil society, and political actors to ensure that parties represent the electorate effectively, enhancing democratic governance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨非洲政党国家执行委员会表面民主背后的实际运作机制，揭示其如何通过不透明操作维持威权主义，阻碍真正政治参与，并提出改革建议。
AI.research_question: 非洲政党国家执行委员会在表面民主的伪装下，其实际运作机制如何影响治理和民主实践？
AI.motivation: 尽管国家执行委员会常被视为民主堡垒，但许多实际上在不透明机制下运作，可能延续威权主义并阻碍真正的政治参与，需要深入研究其结构性和操作性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主理论、政党制度理论、威权主义韧性理论、制度分析框架
AI.method: 系统性定性研究方法，通过结构化方法收集和分析相关在线文献资料及专家意见，选取1971-2015年间51篇同行评议文章，聚焦非洲政党国家执行委员会表面背后的运作机制。
AI.findings: 研究发现国家执行委员会存在内部异议、缺乏透明度、外部行为者影响等问题，表面民主背后实际运作往往阻碍真正政治参与，需要改革政党结构以促进内部民主、增强透明度和包容性参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于揭示了非洲政党制度中形式民主与实际运作的脱节现象，为理解威权主义在民主制度中的韧性提供了新视角，丰富了政党民主化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）呼吁政府改革政党结构；2）反对过度政府干预，倡导支持自我监管和问责的监管框架；3）强调改革国家选举委员会以加强非洲民主；4）促进政府、公民社会和政治行为者合作，确保政党有效代表选民。

title: The Police State vs. The Welfare State
affiliations: Srinivas University

detail.title: The Police State vs. The Welfare State

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No financial relationship
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethical conflicts
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding

detail.abstract: This article looks at the conflict between the police state and the welfare state, which are two different ways of running a country that affect the relationship between the state and its citizens. The police state puts more emphasis on spying, force, and social control to keep order, whereas the welfare state puts more emphasis on social protection, economic redistribution, and public services to improve well-being and social stability. The essay examines the equilibrium between security and social welfare maintained by states in reaction to inequality, economic crises, and perceived threats, utilising political theory, historical instances, and current policy discussions. It contends that excessive dependence on police techniques frequently signifies deteriorated welfare institutions and might intensify social exclusion, whereas resilient welfare systems may mitigate the necessity for coercive control. The study suggests that the long-term legitimacy and stability of modern states rely on establishing a fair equilibrium between security and social provision, rather than favouring repression over social investment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了警察国家与福利国家之间的冲突，分析了两者在国家治理中的不同取向及其对公民关系的影响，认为过度依赖警察手段往往意味着福利制度衰退，而强大的福利体系可以减少强制控制需求，现代国家的长期合法性需要平衡安全与社会福利。
AI.research_question: 警察国家与福利国家之间的冲突如何影响国家与公民的关系？现代国家如何在安全需求与社会福利之间找到平衡点？
AI.motivation: 探讨两种不同国家治理模式（警察国家强调监控与强制控制，福利国家强调社会保护与公共服务）的冲突，分析不平等、经济危机和感知威胁下国家如何平衡安全与社会福利，以及这种平衡对国家合法性和稳定性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治理论框架，包括国家理论、社会契约理论、合法性理论，以及关于警察国家与福利国家的比较政治学理论。
AI.method: 综合运用政治理论分析、历史案例研究和当代政策讨论的混合研究方法。
AI.findings: 过度依赖警察手段往往标志着福利制度的衰退，并可能加剧社会排斥；而强大的福利体系可以减少对强制控制的需求；现代国家的长期合法性和稳定性依赖于在安全与社会福利之间建立公平平衡，而非偏向压制性手段。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了警察国家与福利国家冲突的理论框架，深化了对国家治理模式选择与公民关系影响的理解，为分析国家合法性和稳定性提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了平衡安全需求与社会福利的实践指导，强调投资社会福利体系可以减少对强制控制手段的依赖，促进社会长期稳定和合法性。

title: Evaluating Structural Credit Risk Models for Default Prediction in the Chinese Market
affiliations: Nankai University, Guangdong University of Foreign Studies - School of Accounting and

detail.title: Evaluating Structural Credit Risk Models for Default Prediction in the Chinese Market

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Annual Project of Tianjin Philosophy and Social Sciences Planning [Grant No. TJGL25-08].

detail.abstract: Structural credit risk models are widely used in default prediction practice, yet their effectiveness in the Chinese market remains unclear. Using a comprehensive dataset of recent corporate debt default events, we find that classical structural models have substantially weaker predictive power in China than in international markets. A defining institutional feature is that financially distressed firms often receive support from governments or controlling shareholders. We incorporate this feature into an augmented structural model, which explicitly accounts for external support and delivers a marked improvement in default prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 研究发现经典结构信用风险模型在中国市场的预测能力显著弱于国际市场，主要原因是财务困境企业常获得政府或控股股东支持。通过将外部支持纳入增强型结构模型，可显著提升违约预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 结构信用风险模型在中国市场的违约预测效果如何？为什么经典模型在中国市场表现不佳？如何改进模型以提升预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 结构信用风险模型在国际市场广泛应用，但其在中国市场的有效性尚不明确。了解模型在中国市场的表现差异及原因，对改进违约预测实践有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构信用风险模型（如Merton模型）、制度特征理论、外部支持机制理论
AI.method: 使用近期中国企业债务违约事件的综合数据集，比较经典结构模型在中国和国际市场的预测能力，识别关键制度特征，构建考虑外部支持的增强型结构模型
AI.findings: 1. 经典结构模型在中国市场的预测能力显著弱于国际市场；2. 关键制度特征是财务困境企业常获得政府或控股股东支持；3. 考虑外部支持的增强型结构模型能显著提升违约预测准确性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了制度特征对信用风险模型有效性的重要影响；2. 提出了考虑外部支持的增强型结构模型框架；3. 拓展了结构模型在转型经济体的应用理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者和金融机构提供了更准确的中国市场违约预测工具；2. 帮助监管机构理解中国市场违约风险的特殊性；3. 为企业风险管理提供了改进的评估方法

title: Parallel Futures Deliberation: A Novel Framework for Consensus Building under Socio-Technical Uncertainty
affiliations: Sophia University, Research Institute for Humanity and Nature (RIHN), The University of Tokyo, National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST), National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST), National Institute for Environmental Studies and Research Institute for Humanity and Nature (RIHN)

detail.title: Parallel Futures Deliberation: A Novel Framework for Consensus Building under Socio-Technical Uncertainty

declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by the Research Institute for Humanity and Nature (RIHN: a constituent member of NIHU) Project No. RIHN 14200156.

detail.abstract: The governance of emerging technologies is confounded by the "Collingridge Dilemma." "Upstream" public engagement, or Participatory Technology Assessment (pTA), was developed to address this, but faces persistent, interconnected challenges: deliberation often remains abstract, empowering expert dominance and intensifying value conflicts under high sociotechnical uncertainty. This paper introduces and evaluates a novel framework, "Parallel Futures Deliberation (PFD)," designed to address this syndrome. Tested in a workshop with citizens and experts on the sociotechnical uncertainty of nitrogen circularity, PFD creates a concrete and equitable environment by structuring a sophisticated and complementary division of labor. This structure resolves the problem of expert dominance and grounds the debate in tangible future worlds. The framework systematically generates value conflict from its initial scenario-based assumptions, and then channels that conflict into two distinct, productive outcomes: a substantive synthesis for disagreements over "means," and a procedural consensus for intractable conflicts over "ends."
